===== DETAIL autoMatchLocation =====

function autoMatchLocation() {

      if (
        !state.selectedBuyer
      ) {

        return null;

      }


      const savedLocationId =
        clean(
          state.loadout?.destinationId ||
          state.loadout?.deliveryLocationId ||
          state.ticket.deliveryLocationId
        );


      if (
        savedLocationId
      ) {

        const byId =
          state.locations.find(
            location =>
              location.id ===
                savedLocationId &&
              location.buyerId ===
                state.selectedBuyer.id
          );


        if (
          byId
        ) {

          return byId;

        }

      }


      const candidates =
        state.locations.filter(
          location =>
            location.buyerId ===
            state.selectedBuyer.id
        );


      const ocrStreet =
        compactNormalize(
          state.ticket.ocrDeliveryStreet ||
          state.ticket.deliveryStreet
        );


      const ocrCity =
        compactNormalize(
          state.ticket.ocrDeliveryCity ||
          state.ticket.deliveryCity
        );


      const ocrState =
        compactNormalize(
          state.ticket.ocrDeliveryState ||
          state.ticket.deliveryState
        );


      const ocrZip =
        compactNormalize(
          state.ticket.ocrDeliveryZip ||
          state.ticket.deliveryZip
        );


      if (
        ocrStreet
      ) {

        const streetMatch =
          candidates.find(
            location =>
              compactNormalize(
                location.street
              ) ===
              ocrStreet
          );


        if (
          streetMatch
        ) {

          return streetMatch;

        }

      }


      const cityStateMatches =
        candidates.filter(
          location => {

            const cityMatches =
              !ocrCity ||
              compactNormalize(
                location.city
              ) ===
              ocrCity;


            const stateMatches =
              !ocrState ||
              compactNormalize(
                location.state
              ) ===
              ocrState;


            const zipMatches =
              !ocrZip ||
              compactNormalize(
                location.zip
              ) ===
              ocrZip;


            return (
              cityMatches &&
              stateMatches &&
              zipMatches
            );

          }
        );


      return cityStateMatches.length === 1
        ? cityStateMatches[0]
        : null;

    }

===== DETAIL autoMatchBuyer =====

function autoMatchBuyer() {

      const savedBuyerId =
        clean(
          state.loadout?.buyerId ||
          state.ticket.buyerId
        );


      if (
        savedBuyerId
      ) {

        const byId =
          state.buyers.find(
            buyer =>
              buyer.id ===
              savedBuyerId
          );


        if (
          byId
        ) {

          return byId;

        }

      }


      const source =
        clean(
          state.loadout?.buyerName ||
          state.ticket.ocrElevatorName ||
          state.ticket.buyerName
        );


      if (
        !source
      ) {

        return null;

      }


      const sourceNorm =
        compactNormalize(
          source
        );


      return state.buyers.find(
        buyer => {

          const buyerNorm =
            compactNormalize(
              buyer.name
            );


          return (
            buyerNorm ===
              sourceNorm ||
            buyerNorm.includes(
              sourceNorm
            ) ||
            sourceNorm.includes(
              buyerNorm
            )
          );

        }
      ) ||
      null;

    }

===== DETAIL currentReviewReasons =====

function currentReviewReasons() {

  updateSelectedReferences();


  const reasons =
    [];


  if (
    !state.selectedLocation
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "delivery_location_not_matched"
    );

  }


  /*
    Sold Under rules:

    - no selection = review
    - Unknown = review
    - real linked customer = resolved
  */
  if (
    !state.selectedCustomer
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "customer_not_matched"
    );

  }
  else if (
    state.selectedCustomer.unknown ===
      true
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "sold_under_requires_review"
    );

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.crop.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "crop_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !state.selectedSource
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "grain_source_not_assigned"
    );

  }
  else if (
    clean(
      elements.crop.value
    ) &&
    clean(
      state.selectedSource.crop
    ) &&
    normalize(
      elements.crop.value
    ) !==
      normalize(
        state.selectedSource.crop
      )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "grain_source_crop_mismatch"
    );

  }


  if (
    !state.selectedContract
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "hauling_job_not_assigned"
    );

  }


  /*
    If a REAL Sold Under customer is selected,
    confirm that customer still has at least one
    OPEN contract linked to the selected hauling job.
  */
  if (
    state.selectedContract &&
    state.selectedCustomer &&
    state.selectedCustomer.unknown !==
      true
  ) {

    const validSoldUnder =
      state.contracts.some(
        contract =>
          contractIsOpen(
            contract
          ) &&
          clean(
            contract?.haulingJobId
          ) ===
            clean(
              state.selectedContract.id
            ) &&
          contractCustomerId(
            contract
          ) ===
            clean(
              state.selectedCustomer.id
            )
      );


    if (
      !validSoldUnder &&
      !haulingJobHasUnallocatedContractCapacity(
        state.selectedContract
      )
    ) {

      reasons.push(
        "sold_under_requires_review"
      );

    }

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.ticketNumber.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_number_missing"
    );

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.ticketDate.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_date_missing"
    );

  }


  if (
    !validateWeights()
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_weights_invalid"
    );

  }


  if (
    !validateBushels()
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_bushels_invalid"
    );

  }


  return Array.from(
    new Set(
      reasons
    )
  );

}

===== SCAN findDeliveryLocationMatch =====

function findDeliveryLocationMatch(
  grainTicket
) {

  /*
    DESTINATION MATCHING RULE:

    Destination evidence must come primarily from the
    TOP / HEADER of the scale ticket.

    This keeps customer addresses and "Weigher" information
    from contaminating destination matching.
  */


  const locationAliasText =
    buildLocationAliasText(
      grainTicket
    );


  const learnedLocation =
    findLearnedAlias(
      "delivery_location",
      locationAliasText
    );


  if (
    learnedLocation?.targetId
  ) {

    const location =
      deliveryLocations.find(
        item =>
          item.id ===
          learnedLocation.targetId
      );


    if (
      location
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "learned_alias",

        location
      };

    }

  }


  const normalized =
    value =>
      normalizeMatchText(
        value
      );


  const elevatorText =
    String(
      grainTicket?.elevatorName ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const headerText =
    getTicketHeaderText(
      grainTicket
    );


  const normalizedElevator =
    normalized(
      elevatorText
    );


  const normalizedHeader =
    normalized(
      headerText
    );


  const headerCityState =
    findCityStateInTicketHeader(
      grainTicket
    );


  const ocrStreet =
    normalizeStreetForMatch(
      grainTicket?.deliveryStreet
    );


  const ocrCity =
    normalized(
      headerCityState.city ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryCity
    );


  const ocrState =
    normalized(
      headerCityState.state ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryState
    );


  const ocrZip =
    normalizeZipForMatch(
      headerCityState.zip ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryZip
    );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Destination OCR clues:",
    {
      elevatorText,
      headerText,
      city:
        grainTicket?.deliveryCity ||
        headerCityState.city ||
        null,

      state:
        grainTicket?.deliveryState ||
        headerCityState.state ||
        null,

      zip:
        grainTicket?.deliveryZip ||
        headerCityState.zip ||
        null
    }
  );


  const scored =
    deliveryLocations
      .map(
        location => {

          const locationStreet =
            normalizeStreetForMatch(
              getLocationStreet(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationCity =
            normalized(
              getLocationCity(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationState =
            normalized(
              getLocationState(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationZip =
            normalizeZipForMatch(
              getLocationZip(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationName =
            normalized(
              getLocationName(
                location
              )
            );


          const buyerName =
            normalized(
              location.buyerName ||
              ""
            );


          let score =
            0;


          const reasons =
            [];


          /*
            Exact destination street.
          */

          if (
            ocrStreet &&
            locationStreet &&
            ocrStreet ===
              locationStreet
          ) {

            score +=
              70;


            reasons.push(
              "street"
            );

          }


          /*
            ZIP.
          */

          if (
            ocrZip &&
            locationZip &&
            ocrZip ===
              locationZip
          ) {

            score +=
              50;


            reasons.push(
              "zip"
            );

          }


          /*
            City and state from the ticket HEADER.
          */

          if (
            ocrCity &&
            locationCity &&
            ocrCity ===
              locationCity
          ) {

            score +=
              45;


            reasons.push(
              "city"
            );

          }


          if (
            ocrState &&
            locationState &&
            ocrState ===
              locationState
          ) {

            score +=
              15;


            reasons.push(
              "state"
            );

          }


          /*
            FarmVista location name appears in the OCR elevator
            name or header.

            Example:

              Cahokia Grain
              Cahokia, IL
          */

          if (
            locationName &&
            (
              normalizedElevator.includes(
                locationName
              ) ||
              normalizedHeader.includes(
                locationName
              )
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              35;


            reasons.push(
              "location_name"
            );

          }


          /*
            Buyer/company appears in the HEADER.

            We deliberately use only header text here rather
            than the entire OCR document.
          */

          if (
            buyerName &&
            normalizedHeader.includes(
              buyerName
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              35;


            reasons.push(
              "buyer"
            );

          }


          /*
            Partial location-name similarity.

            This helps with names such as:

              Cahokia Grain

            versus an internal FarmVista location whose
            descriptive name contains "Cahokia".
          */

          const nameSimilarity =
            smartNameSimilarity(
              elevatorText,
              getLocationName(
                location
              )
            );


          if (
            nameSimilarity >=
            0.5
          ) {

            score +=
              Math.round(
                nameSimilarity *
                30
              );


            reasons.push(
              "name_similarity"
            );

          }


          return {
            location,
            score,
            reasons
          };

        }
      )
      .filter(
        item =>
          item.score >
          0
      )
      .sort(
        (
          a,
          b
        ) =>
          b.score -
          a.score
      );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Delivery location scoring:",
    scored.map(
      item => ({
        id:
          item.location.id,

        buyer:
          item.location.buyerName,

        location:
          getLocationName(
            item.location
          ),

        city:
          getLocationCity(
            item.location
          ),

        state:
          getLocationState(
            item.location
          ),

        score:
          item.score,

        reasons:
          item.reasons
      })
    )
  );


  if (
    !scored.length
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        false,

      matchType:
        null,

      location:
        null
    };

  }


  const best =
    scored[0];


  const secondBest =
    scored[1] ||
    null;


  const strongIdentityClues =
    best.reasons.filter(
      reason =>
        [
          "street",
          "zip",
          "city",
          "location_name",
          "buyer"
        ].includes(
          reason
        )
    ).length;


  /*
    Examples we WANT to accept:

      Cahokia + IL + location-name clue
      city + buyer
      exact street + another clue
      ZIP + another clue

    We still require the winner to be clearly better than
    another possible destination.
  */

  const meetsThreshold =
    (
      best.score >=
        75 &&
      strongIdentityClues >=
        2
    ) ||
    (
      best.score >=
        95
    );


  const clearlyBetter =
    !secondBest ||
    (
      best.score -
      secondBest.score
    ) >=
      20;


  if (
    meetsThreshold &&
    clearlyBetter
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        true,

      matchType:
        "smart_location",

      location:
        best.location
    };

  }


  /*
    Unique exact street remains safe enough to accept.
  */

  if (
    ocrStreet
  ) {

    const streetMatches =
      deliveryLocations.filter(
        location =>
          normalizeStreetForMatch(
            getLocationStreet(
              location
            )
          ) ===
            ocrStreet
      );


    if (
      streetMatches.length ===
      1
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "unique_street",

        location:
          streetMatches[0]
      };

    }

  }


  console.warn(
    "[Grain Ticket] Delivery location not confidently matched:",
    {
      best:
        best
          ? {
              id:
                best.location.id,

              name:
                getLocationName(
                  best.location
                ),

              score:
                best.score,

              reasons:
                best.reasons
            }
          : null,

      secondBest:
        secondBest
          ? {
              id:
                secondBest.location.id,

              name:
                getLocationName(
                  secondBest.location
                ),

              score:
                secondBest.score,

              reasons:
                secondBest.reasons
            }
          : null
    }
  );


  return {
    matched:
      false,

    matchType:
      null,

    location:
      null
  };

}

===== SCAN findBuyerMatch =====

function findBuyerMatch(
  grainTicket,
  locationMatch
) {

  /*
    First preference:
    use the buyer tied to the matched delivery location.
  */

  if (
    locationMatch?.location
  ) {

    const locationBuyerId =
      String(
        firstExistingValue(
          locationMatch.location,
          [
            "buyerId",
            "grainBuyerId"
          ]
        ) || ""
      );


    if (
      locationBuyerId
    ) {

      const buyer =
        buyers.find(
          item =>
            String(
              item.id
            ) ===
            locationBuyerId
        );


      if (
        buyer
      ) {

        return {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            "location_buyer",

          buyer
        };

      }

    }

  }


/*
  If location did not identify the buyer,
  check a learned buyer alias next.
*/

const learnedBuyer =
  findLearnedAlias(
    "buyer",
    grainTicket?.elevatorName
  );


if (
  learnedBuyer?.targetId
) {

  const buyer =
    buyers.find(
      item =>
        item.id ===
        learnedBuyer.targetId
    );


  if (
    buyer
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        true,

      matchType:
        "learned_alias",

      buyer
    };

  }

}


/*
  Otherwise compare OCR elevator text to FarmVista buyer names.
*/

const ocrElevator =
  normalizeMatchText(
    grainTicket?.elevatorName
  );


  if (
    ocrElevator
  ) {

    const buyer =
      buyers.find(
        item => {

          const buyerName =
            normalizeMatchText(
              getBuyerName(
                item
              )
            );


          return (
            buyerName ===
              ocrElevator ||
            buyerName.includes(
              ocrElevator
            ) ||
            ocrElevator.includes(
              buyerName
            )
          );

        }
      );


    if (
      buyer
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "elevator_name",

        buyer
      };

    }

  }


  return {
    matched:
      false,

    matchType:
      null,

    buyer:
      null
  };

}

===== SCAN findCityStateInTicketHeader =====

function findCityStateInTicketHeader(
  grainTicket
) {

  const lines =
    getOcrLines(
      grainTicket
    )
      .slice(
        0,
        8
      );


  for (
    const line of
    lines
  ) {

    const match =
      line.match(
        /^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]*?),?\s+([A-Z]{2})(?:\s+(\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?))?$/i
      );


    if (
      !match
    ) {

      continue;

    }


    return {

      city:
        String(
          match[1] ||
          ""
        ).trim(),

      state:
        String(
          match[2] ||
          ""
        ).trim(),

      zip:
        String(
          match[3] ||
          ""
        ).trim()

    };

  }


  return {
    city:
      "",

    state:
      "",

    zip:
      ""
  };

}


// ==========================================================
// DESTINATION / DELIVERY LOCATION
// ==========================================================

function findDeliveryLocationMatch(
  grainTicket
) {

  /*
    DESTINATION MATCHING RULE:

    Destination evidence must come primarily from the
    TOP / HEADER of the scale ticket.

    This keeps customer addresses and "Weigher" information
    from contaminating destination matching.
  */


  const locationAliasText =
    buildLocationAliasText(
      grainTicket
    );


  const learnedLocation =
    findLearnedAlias(
      "delivery_location",
      locationAliasText
    );


  if (
    learnedLocation?.targetId
  ) {

    const location =
      deliveryLocations.find(
        item =>
          item.id ===
          learnedLocation.targetId
      );


    if (
      location
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "learned_alias",

        location
      };

    }

  }


  const normalized =
    value =>
      normalizeMatchText(
        value
      );


  const elevatorText =
    String(
      grainTicket?.elevatorName ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const headerText =
    getTicketHeaderText(
      grainTicket
    );


  const normalizedElevator =
    normalized(
      elevatorText
    );


  const normalizedHeader =
    normalized(
      headerText
    );


  const headerCityState =
    findCityStateInTicketHeader(
      grainTicket
    );


  const ocrStreet =
    normalizeStreetForMatch(
      grainTicket?.deliveryStreet
    );


  const ocrCity =
    normalized(
      headerCityState.city ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryCity
    );


  const ocrState =
    normalized(
      headerCityState.state ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryState
    );


  const ocrZip =
    normalizeZipForMatch(
      headerCityState.zip ||
      grainTicket?.deliveryZip
    );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Destination OCR clues:",
    {
      elevatorText,
      headerText,
      city:
        grainTicket?.deliveryCity ||
        headerCityState.city ||
        null,

      state:
        grainTicket?.deliveryState ||
        headerCityState.state ||
        null,

      zip:
        grainTicket?.deliveryZip ||
        headerCityState.zip ||
        null
    }
  );


  const scored =
    deliveryLocations
      .map(
        location => {

          const locationStreet =
            normalizeStreetForMatch(
              getLocationStreet(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationCity =
            normalized(
              getLocationCity(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationState =
            normalized(
              getLocationState(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationZip =
            normalizeZipForMatch(
              getLocationZip(
                location
              )
            );


          const locationName =
            normalized(
              getLocationName(
                location
              )
            );


          const buyerName =
            normalized(
              location.buyerName ||
              ""
            );


          let score =
            0;


          const reasons =
            [];


          /*
            Exact destination street.
          */

          if (
            ocrStreet &&
            locationStreet &&
            ocrStreet ===
              locationStreet
          ) {

            score +=
              70;


            reasons.push(
              "street"
            );

          }


          /*
            ZIP.
          */

          if (
            ocrZip &&
            locationZip &&
            ocrZip ===
              locationZip
          ) {

            score +=
              50;


            reasons.push(
              "zip"
            );

          }


          /*
            City and state from the ticket HEADER.
          */

          if (
            ocrCity &&
            locationCity &&
            ocrCity ===
              locationCity
          ) {

            score +=
              45;


            reasons.push(
              "city"
            );

          }


          if (
            ocrState &&
            locationState &&
            ocrState ===
              locationState
          ) {

            score +=
              15;


            reasons.push(
              "state"
            );

          }


          /*
            FarmVista location name appears in the OCR elevator
            name or header.

            Example:

              Cahokia Grain
              Cahokia, IL
          */

          if (
            locationName &&
            (
              normalizedElevator.includes(
                locationName
              ) ||
              normalizedHeader.includes(
                locationName
              )
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              35;


            reasons.push(
              "location_name"
            );

          }


          /*
            Buyer/company appears in the HEADER.

            We deliberately use only header text here rather
            than the entire OCR document.
          */

          if (
            buyerName &&
            normalizedHeader.includes(
              buyerName
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              35;


            reasons.push(
              "buyer"
            );

          }


          /*
            Partial location-name similarity.

            This helps with names such as:

              Cahokia Grain

            versus an internal FarmVista location whose
            descriptive name contains "Cahokia".
          */

          const nameSimilarity =
            smartNameSimilarity(
              elevatorText,
              getLocationName(
                location
              )
            );


          if (
            nameSimilarity >=
            0.5
          ) {

            score +=
              Math.round(
                nameSimilarity *
                30
              );


            reasons.push(
              "name_similarity"
            );

          }


          return {
            location,
            score,
            reasons
          };

        }
      )
      .filter(
        item =>
          item.score >
          0
      )
      .sort(
        (
          a,
          b
        ) =>
          b.score -
          a.score
      );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Delivery location scoring:",
    scored.map(
      item => ({
        id:
          item.location.id,

        buyer:
          item.location.buyerName,

        location:
          getLocationName(
            item.location
          ),

        city:
          getLocationCity(
            item.location
          ),

        state:
          getLocationState(
            item.location
          ),

        score:
          item.score,

        reasons:
          item.reasons
      })
    )
  );


  if (
    !scored.length
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        false,

      matchType:
        null,

      location:
        null
    };

  }


  const best =
    scored[0];


  const secondBest =
    scored[1] ||
    null;


  const strongIdentityClues =
    best.reasons.filter(
      reason =>
        [
          "street",
          "zip",
          "city",
          "location_name",
          "buyer"
        ].includes(
          reason
        )
    ).length;


  /*
    Examples we WANT to accept:

      Cahokia + IL + location-name clue
      city + buyer
      exact street + another clue
      ZIP + another clue

    We still require the winner to be clearly better than
    another possible destination.
  */

  const meetsThreshold =
    (
      best.score >=
        75 &&
      strongIdentityClues >=
        2
    ) ||
    (
      best.score >=
        95
    );


  const clearlyBetter =
    !secondBest ||
    (
      best.score -
      secondBest.score
    ) >=
      20;


  if (
    meetsThreshold &&
    clearlyBetter
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        true,

      matchType:
        "smart_location",

      location:
        best.location
    };

  }


  /*
    Unique exact street remains safe enough to accept.
  */

  if (
    ocrStreet
  ) {

    const streetMatches =
      deliveryLocations.filter(
        location =>
          normalizeStreetForMatch(
            getLocationStreet(
              location
            )
          ) ===
            ocrStreet
      );


    if (
      streetMatches.length ===
      1
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "unique_street",

        location:
          streetMatches[0]
      };

    }

  }


  console.warn(
    "[Grain Ticket] Delivery location not confidently matched:",
    {
      best:
        best
          ? {
              id:
                best.location.id,

              name:
                getLocationName(
                  best.location
                ),

              score:
                best.score,

              reasons:
                best.reasons
            }
          : null,

      secondBest:
        secondBest
          ? {
              id:
                secondBest.location.id,

              name:
                getLocationName(
                  secondBest.location
                ),

              score:
                secondBest.score,

              reasons:
                secondBest.reasons
            }
          : null
    }
  );


  return {
    matched:
      false,

    matchType:
      null,

    location:
      null
  };

}


// ==========================================================
// CUSTOMER / SOLD UNDER
// ==========================================================

function getCustomerCandidateIds(
  grainTicket,
  locationMatch,
  buyerMatch
) {

  const crop =
    normalizeMatchText(
      grainTicket?.crop
    );


  const locationId =
    String(
      locationMatch?.location?.id ||
      ""
    );


  const buyerId =
    String(
      buyerMatch?.buyer?.id ||
      locationMatch?.location?.buyerId ||
      ""
    );


  const ids =
    new Set();


  /*
    IMPORTANT:

    We are NOT assigning a contract here.

    Contracts are only being used to determine which FarmVista
    customers are realistically capable of being "Sold Under"
    for this crop / destination / buyer.
  */

  for (
    const contract of
    contracts
  ) {

    if (
      contract?.voided ===
      true
    ) {

      continue;

    }


    const contractCrop =
      normalizeMatchText(
        firstExistingValue(
          contract,
          [
            "crop",
            "commodity"
          ]
        )
      );


    if (
      crop &&
      contractCrop &&
      crop !==
        contractCrop
    ) {

      continue;

    }


    const contractLocationId =
      String(
        firstExistingValue(
          contract,
          [
            "deliveryLocationId",
            "locationId"
          ]
        ) || ""
      );


    const contractBuyerId =
      String(
        firstExistingValue(
          contract,
          [
            "buyerId",
            "grainBuyerId"
          ]
        ) || ""
      );


    /*
      If the contract has a specific location, respect it.

      If older contracts only contain buyerId, they may still
      be useful as candidates.
    */

    if (
      locationId &&
      contractLocationId &&
      contractLocationId !==
        locationId
    ) {

      continue;

    }


    if (
      buyerId &&
      contractBuyerId &&
      contractBuyerId !==
        buyerId
    ) {

      continue;

    }


    const customerId =
      String(
        firstExistingValue(
          contract,
          [
            "customerId",
            "grainCustomerId"
          ]
        ) || ""
      );


    if (
      customerId
    ) {

      ids.add(
        customerId
      );

    }

  }


  return ids;

}


function findCustomerBlockClues(
  grainTicket
) {

  const lines =
    getOcrLines(
      grainTicket
    );


  const result = {
    account:
      String(
        grainTicket?.customerAccountText ||
        ""
      ).trim(),

    name:
      String(
        grainTicket?.customerText ||
        ""
      ).trim(),

    nearbyText:
      ""
  };


  /*
    Find the part of the OCR document around:

      Cust ID
      Customer
      Customer ID
      Account

    Then use only a small nearby block. This avoids accidentally
    treating Weight/Bu., Weigher, or other distant labels as the
    customer.
  */

  let anchorIndex =
    -1;


  for (
    let i = 0;
    i < lines.length;
    i++
  ) {

    const normalizedLine =
      normalizeAliasText(
        lines[i]
      );


    if (
      normalizedLine ===
        "cust id" ||
      normalizedLine ===
        "customer id" ||
      normalizedLine ===
        "customer" ||
      normalizedLine ===
        "account" ||
      normalizedLine ===
        "account id"
    ) {

      anchorIndex =
        i;

      break;

    }

  }


  if (
    anchorIndex >=
    0
  ) {

    result.nearbyText =
      lines
        .slice(
          anchorIndex,
          Math.min(
            lines.length,
            anchorIndex + 7
          )
        )
        .join(
          " "
        );

  }


  return result;

}


function findCustomerMatch(
  grainTicket,
  locationMatch,
  buyerMatch
) {

  const clues =
    findCustomerBlockClues(
      grainTicket
    );


  const ocrName =
    String(
      clues.name ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const ocrAccount =
    String(
      clues.account ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  /*
    Build the SAFE candidate list first.

    If destination/buyer/crop tells us that only a few
    FarmVista customers are possible, do not compare against
    every customer in the database.
  */

  const candidateIds =
    getCustomerCandidateIds(
      grainTicket,
      locationMatch,
      buyerMatch
    );


  let candidates =
    customers;


  if (
    candidateIds.size
  ) {

    candidates =
      customers.filter(
        customer =>
          candidateIds.has(
            String(
              customer.id
            )
          )
      );

  }


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Customer candidate scope:",
    {
      candidateCount:
        candidates.length,

      narrowedByContracts:
        candidateIds.size >
        0,

      candidates:
        candidates.map(
          customer => ({
            id:
              customer.id,

            name:
              getCustomerName(
                customer
              )
          })
        )
    }
  );


  /*
    Learned customer aliases are still supported, but only
    when the learned target is also valid for this destination
    context.
  */

  if (
    ocrName
  ) {

    const alias =
      findLearnedAlias(
        "customer",
        ocrName
      );


    if (
      alias?.targetId
    ) {

      const customer =
        candidates.find(
          item =>
            item.id ===
            alias.targetId
        );


      if (
        customer
      ) {

        return {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            "learned_alias",

          customer
        };

      }

    }

  }


  /*
    RAW TICKET CUSTOMER-NAME FALLBACK

    Some ADM tickets put the vendor/account number immediately before
    the Sold Under name. If the structured customer field is imperfect
    but one FarmVista candidate's meaningful name appears verbatim in
    the OCR document, that is strong evidence.

    Require exactly one candidate so we never guess between two names.
  */

  const rawCustomerText =
    normalizeMatchText(
      grainTicket?.rawText ||
      ""
    );


  if (
    rawCustomerText
  ) {

    const rawNameMatches =
      candidates.filter(
        customer => {

          const nameWords =
            normalizeSmartWords(
              getCustomerName(
                customer
              )
            );


          if (
            nameWords.length <
              2
          ) {

            return false;

          }


          const normalizedName =
            nameWords.join(
              " "
            );


          return rawCustomerText.includes(
            normalizedName
          );

        }
      );


    if (
      rawNameMatches.length ===
        1
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "raw_ticket_customer_name",

        customer:
          rawNameMatches[0]
      };

    }

  }


  /*
    ACCOUNT NUMBER.

    Strong when FarmVista actually stores the same account ID.
  */

  if (
    ocrAccount
  ) {

    const accountNormalized =
      normalizeMatchText(
        ocrAccount
      );


    const accountMatches =
      candidates.filter(
        customer => {

          const customerAccount =
            normalizeMatchText(
              getCustomerAccount(
                customer
              )
            );


          return (
            customerAccount &&
            customerAccount ===
              accountNormalized
          );

        }
      );


    if (
      accountMatches.length ===
      1
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "account",

        customer:
          accountMatches[0]
      };

    }

  }


  /*
    SCORE NAME + CUSTOMER BLOCK INFORMATION.

    This handles:

      OCR:
        JOHN C DOWSON

      FarmVista:
        John C Dowson Inc.

    without requiring a global alias.
  */

  const customerBlockNormalized =
    normalizeMatchText(
      clues.nearbyText
    );


  const scored =
    candidates
      .map(
        customer => {

          const customerName =
            getCustomerName(
              customer
            );


          const similarity =
            smartNameSimilarity(
              ocrName,
              customerName
            );


          let score =
            0;


          const reasons =
            [];


          if (
            ocrName &&
            normalizeMatchText(
              ocrName
            ) ===
              normalizeMatchText(
                customerName
              )
          ) {

            score +=
              100;


            reasons.push(
              "exact_name"
            );

          }
          else if (
            similarity ===
            1
          ) {

            /*
              Same meaningful name words after removing things
              such as Inc., LLC, Company, punctuation, etc.
            */

            score +=
              90;


            reasons.push(
              "normalized_name"
            );

          }
          else if (
            similarity >=
            0.75
          ) {

            score +=
              70;


            reasons.push(
              "strong_name"
            );

          }
          else if (
            similarity >=
            0.5
          ) {

            score +=
              45;


            reasons.push(
              "partial_name"
            );

          }


          /*
            Address clues found near the Cust ID block can add
            confidence, but cannot create a match by themselves.
          */

          const customerStreet =
            normalizeStreetForMatch(
              getCustomerStreet(
                customer
              )
            );


          const customerCity =
            normalizeMatchText(
              getCustomerCity(
                customer
              )
            );


          const customerState =
            normalizeMatchText(
              getCustomerState(
                customer
              )
            );


          const customerZip =
            normalizeZipForMatch(
              getCustomerZip(
                customer
              )
            );


          if (
            customerStreet &&
            customerBlockNormalized.includes(
              customerStreet
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              25;


            reasons.push(
              "customer_street"
            );

          }


          if (
            customerCity &&
            customerBlockNormalized.includes(
              customerCity
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              15;


            reasons.push(
              "customer_city"
            );

          }


          if (
            customerState &&
            customerBlockNormalized.includes(
              customerState
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              5;


            reasons.push(
              "customer_state"
            );

          }


          if (
            customerZip &&
            customerBlockNormalized.includes(
              customerZip
            )
          ) {

            score +=
              15;


            reasons.push(
              "customer_zip"
            );

          }


          return {
            customer,
            score,
            similarity,
            reasons
          };

        }
      )
      .filter(
        item =>
          item.score >
          0
      )
      .sort(
        (
          a,
          b
        ) =>
          b.score -
          a.score
      );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Customer scoring:",
    scored.map(
      item => ({
        id:
          item.customer.id,

        name:
          getCustomerName(
            item.customer
          ),

        score:
          item.score,

        similarity:
          item.similarity,

        reasons:
          item.reasons
      })
    )
  );


  if (
    scored.length
  ) {

    const best =
      scored[0];


    const secondBest =
      scored[1] ||
      null;


    const clearlyBetter =
      !secondBest ||
      (
        best.score -
        secondBest.score
      ) >=
        20;


    /*
      A strong name match is required.

      Address/city information only supports the identity;
      it cannot independently choose a customer.
    */

    const hasStrongName =
      best.reasons.includes(
        "exact_name"
      ) ||
      best.reasons.includes(
        "normalized_name"
      ) ||
      best.reasons.includes(
        "strong_name"
      );


    if (
      hasStrongName &&
      best.score >=
        70 &&
      clearlyBetter
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          candidateIds.size
            ? "context_customer"
            : "smart_customer",

        customer:
          best.customer
      };

    }

  }


  /*
    FINAL SAFE FALLBACK:

    If destination/crop/buyer narrowed FarmVista to exactly
    ONE possible customer AND OCR gave us a meaningful name,
    allow a moderate name similarity.

    We still do NOT blindly choose the only contract customer
    when OCR customer text is garbage such as Weight/Bu.
  */

  if (
    candidateIds.size &&
    candidates.length ===
      1 &&
    ocrName &&
    smartNameSimilarity(
      ocrName,
      getCustomerName(
        candidates[0]
      )
    ) >=
      0.5
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        true,

      matchType:
        "unique_context_customer",

      customer:
        candidates[0]
    };

  }


  return {
    matched:
      false,

    matchType:
      null,

    customer:
      null
  };

}


function findBuyerMatch(
  grainTicket,
  locationMatch
) {

  /*
    First preference:
    use the buyer tied to the matched delivery location.
  */

  if (
    locationMatch?.location
  ) {

    const locationBuyerId =
      String(
        firstExistingValue(
          locationMatch.location,
          [
            "buyerId",
            "grainBuyerId"
          ]
        ) || ""
      );


    if (
      locationBuyerId
    ) {

      const buyer =
        buyers.find(
          item =>
            String(
              item.id
            ) ===
            locationBuyerId
        );


      if (
        buyer
      ) {

        return {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            "location_buyer",

          buyer
        };

      }

    }

  }


/*
  If location did not identify the buyer,
  check a learned buyer alias next.
*/

const learnedBuyer =
  findLearnedAlias(
    "buyer",
    grainTicket?.elevatorName
  );


if (
  learnedBuyer?.targetId
) {

  const buyer =
    buyers.find(
      item =>
        item.id ===
        learnedBuyer.targetId
    );


  if (
    buyer
  ) {

    return {
      matched:
        true,

      matchType:
        "learned_alias",

      buyer
    };

  }

}


/*
  Otherwise compare OCR elevator text to FarmVista buyer names.
*/

const ocrElevator =
  normalizeMatchText(
    grainTicket?.elevatorName
  );


  if (
    ocrElevator
  ) {

    const buyer =
      buyers.find(
        item => {

          const buyerName =
            normalizeMatchText(
              getBuyerName(
                item
              )
            );


          return (
            buyerName ===
              ocrElevator ||
            buyerName.includes(
              ocrElevator
            ) ||
            ocrElevator.includes(
              buyerName
            )
          );

        }
      );


    if (
      buyer
    ) {

      return {
        matched:
          true,

        matchType:
          "elevator_name",

        buyer
      };

    }

  }


  return {
    matched:
      false,

    matchType:
      null,

    buyer:
      null
  };

}


function findContractMatches(
  grainTicket,
  customerMatch
) {

  if (
    !customerMatch?.customer ||
    !grainTicket?.crop
  ) {

    return [];

  }


  const customerId =
    String(
      customerMatch.customer.id
    );


  const crop =
    normalizeMatchText(
      grainTicket.crop
    );


  return contracts.filter(
    contract => {

      const contractCustomerId =
        String(
          firstExistingValue(
            contract,
            [
              "customerId",
              "grainCustomerId"
            ]
          ) || ""
        );


      const contractCrop =
        normalizeMatchText(
          firstExistingValue(
            contract,
            [
              "crop",
              "commodity"
            ]
          )
        );


      return (
        contractCustomerId ===
          customerId &&
        contractCrop ===
          crop
      );

    }
  );

}


function matchScannedTicket(
  grainTicket
) {

  /*
    MATCH IN DEPENDENCY ORDER.

    1. Destination / delivery location
    2. Buyer tied to that destination
    3. Customer / Sold Under narrowed by
       destination + buyer + crop + contracts

    This is intentionally different from the old logic,
    where all three identities were guessed independently.
  */


  const locationMatch =
    findDeliveryLocationMatch(
      grainTicket
    );


  const buyerMatch =
    findBuyerMatch(
      grainTicket,
      locationMatch
    );


  const customerMatch =
    findCustomerMatch(
      grainTicket,
      locationMatch,
      buyerMatch
    );


  /*
    CONTRACTS ARE NOT ASSIGNED DURING SCANNING.

    Contracts are used above only as matching evidence
    to narrow the possible customer / Sold Under choices.

    Actual contract assignment still happens later during
    grain-ticket reconciliation.
  */

  const contractMatches =
    [];


  const reviewReasons =
    [];


  if (
    !locationMatch.matched
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "delivery_location_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !buyerMatch.matched
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "buyer_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !customerMatch.matched
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "customer_not_matched"
    );

  }


  const validationStatus =
    reviewReasons.length
      ? "needs_review"
      : "verified";


  const result = {

    locationMatch,

    buyerMatch,

    customerMatch,

    contractMatches,

    validationStatus,

    reviewReasons

  };


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] FarmVista hierarchical matching:",
    {
      destination: {
        matched:
          locationMatch.matched,

        matchType:
          locationMatch.matchType,

        id:
          locationMatch.location?.id ||
          null,

        name:
          locationMatch.location
            ? getLocationName(
                locationMatch.location
              )
            : null
      },

      buyer: {
        matched:
          buyerMatch.matched,

        matchType:
          buyerMatch.matchType,

        id:
          buyerMatch.buyer?.id ||
          null,

        name:
          buyerMatch.buyer
            ? getBuyerName(
                buyerMatch.buyer
              )
            : null
      },

      customer: {
        matched:
          customerMatch.matched,

        matchType:
          customerMatch.matchType,

        id:
          customerMatch.customer?.id ||
          null,

        name:
          customerMatch.customer
            ? getCustomerName(
                customerMatch.customer
              )
            : null
      },

      crop:
        grainTicket?.crop ||
        null,

      validationStatus,

      reviewReasons

    }
  );


  return result;

}

// ==========================================================
// DRIVER ASSIST
// ==========================================================

const DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK =
  "__driver_assist_back__";


function syncDriverAssistFooter(
  allowBack,
  allowSkip
) {

  if (
    assistBackBtn
  ) {

    assistBackBtn.style.display =
      allowBack
        ? ""
        : "none";

  }


  if (
    assistSkipBtn
  ) {

    assistSkipBtn.style.display =
      allowSkip
        ? ""
        : "none";

  }


  if (
    assistFootActions
  ) {

    const visibleCount =
      Number(
        !!allowBack
      ) +
      Number(
        !!allowSkip
      );


    assistFootActions.classList.toggle(
      "single",
      visibleCount <= 1
    );

  }

}


function closeDriverAssist(
  value
) {

  assistScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  assistBody.innerHTML =
    "";


  const resolve =
    currentAssistResolver;


  currentAssistResolver =
    null;


  if (
    resolve
  ) {

    resolve(
      value
    );

  }

}


function askDriverButtons({
  step = "Driver Assist",
  title,
  text = "",
  choices = [],
  allowSkip = true,
  allowBack = false
}) {

  return new Promise(
    resolve => {

      currentAssistResolver =
        resolve;


      assistStep.textContent =
        step;


      assistTitle.textContent =
        title;


      assistText.textContent =
        text;


      assistBody.innerHTML =
        "";


      syncDriverAssistFooter(
        allowBack,
        allowSkip
      );


      const list =
        document.createElement(
          "div"
        );


      list.className =
        "assist-button-list";


      choices.forEach(
        choice => {

          const button =
            document.createElement(
              "button"
            );


          button.type =
            "button";


          button.className =
            "assist-choice big";


          button.textContent =
            choice.label;


          button.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () =>
              closeDriverAssist(
                choice.value
              )
          );


          list.appendChild(
            button
          );

        }
      );


      if (
        !choices.length
      ) {

        const empty =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        empty.className =
          "assist-empty";


        empty.textContent =
          "No matching options are currently available.";


        list.appendChild(
          empty
        );

      }


      assistBody.appendChild(
        list
      );


      assistScreen.classList.add(
        "show"
      );

    }
  );

}


function askDriverSearchList({
  step = "Driver Assist",
  title,
  text = "",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  items = [],
  groups = null,
  allowSkip = true,
  allowBack = false
}) {

  return new Promise(
    resolve => {

      currentAssistResolver =
        resolve;


      assistStep.textContent =
        step;


      assistTitle.textContent =
        title;


      assistText.textContent =
        text;


      syncDriverAssistFooter(
        allowBack,
        allowSkip
      );


      assistBody.innerHTML =
        "";


      /*
        Grain Source uses the cleaner searchable-dropdown UI.

        Destination/customer/etc. keep the existing search-list
        behavior so this change stays limited to Fields,
        Bin Sites and Grain Bag Sites.
      */

/*
  Use the normal FarmVista searchable dropdown for every Driver Assist list.
  Field and Grain Storage should look and behave like the dropdown the driver
  already knows; touch safety is handled without changing the UI.
*/
const useDropdown =
  true;


      if (
        useDropdown
      ) {

        const dropdown =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        dropdown.className =
          "assist-dropdown";


        const trigger =
          document.createElement(
            "button"
          );


        trigger.type =
          "button";


        trigger.className =
          "assist-dropdown-trigger";


        const triggerText =
          document.createElement(
            "span"
          );


        triggerText.className =
          "assist-dropdown-placeholder";


        triggerText.textContent =
          "Select an option…";


        trigger.appendChild(
          triggerText
        );


        const menu =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        menu.className =
          "assist-dropdown-menu";


        const searchWrap =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        searchWrap.className =
          "assist-dropdown-search";


        const searchInput =
          document.createElement(
            "input"
          );


        searchInput.type =
          "search";


        searchInput.className =
          "assist-search";


        searchInput.placeholder =
          placeholder;


        searchInput.autocomplete =
          "off";


        searchWrap.appendChild(
          searchInput
        );


        menu.appendChild(
          searchWrap
        );


        const results =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        results.className =
          "assist-dropdown-results";


        menu.appendChild(
          results
        );


        dropdown.appendChild(
          trigger
        );


        dropdown.appendChild(
          menu
        );


        assistBody.appendChild(
          dropdown
        );


        const render =
          () => {

            results.innerHTML =
              "";


            const search =
              normalizeAliasText(
                searchInput.value
              );


            const filtered =
              items.filter(
                item =>
                  !search ||
                  normalizeAliasText(
                    `${item.label} ${item.searchText || ""}`
                  ).includes(
                    search
                  )
              );


            if (
              !filtered.length
            ) {

              const empty =
                document.createElement(
                  "div"
                );


              empty.className =
                "assist-empty";


              empty.textContent =
                "No matching options were found.";


              results.appendChild(
                empty
              );


              return;

            }


            const renderGroups =
              groups ||
              [
                {
                  title:
                    "",

                  test:
                    () =>
                      true
                }
              ];


            renderGroups.forEach(
              group => {

                const groupItems =
                  filtered.filter(
                    group.test
                  );


                if (
                  !groupItems.length
                ) {

                  return;

                }


                if (
                  group.title
                ) {

                  const heading =
                    document.createElement(
                      "div"
                    );


                  heading.className =
                    "assist-group";


                  heading.textContent =
                    group.title;


                  results.appendChild(
                    heading
                  );

                }


                groupItems.forEach(
                  item => {

                    const option =
                      document.createElement(
                        "button"
                      );


                    option.type =
                      "button";


                    option.className =
                      "assist-dropdown-option";


                    option.textContent =
                      item.label;


                    option.addEventListener(
                      "click",
                      () => {

                        triggerText.textContent =
                          item.label;


                        triggerText.className =
                          "";


                        dropdown.classList.remove(
                          "open"
                        );


                        closeDriverAssist(
                          item.value
                        );

                      }
                    );


                    results.appendChild(
                      option
                    );

                  }
                );

              }
            );

          };


        trigger.addEventListener(
          "click",
          () => {

            const opening =
              !dropdown.classList.contains(
                "open"
              );


            dropdown.classList.toggle(
              "open"
            );


            if (
              opening
            ) {

              setTimeout(
                () =>
                  searchInput.focus(),
                50
              );

            }

          }
        );


        searchInput.addEventListener(
          "input",
          render
        );


        searchInput.addEventListener(
          "click",
          event =>
            event.stopPropagation()
        );


        render();

      }
      else {

        /*
          Existing Driver Assist search UI for destinations,
          customers and any other non-Grain-Source questions.
        */

        const searchWrap =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        searchWrap.className =
          "assist-search-wrap";


        const searchInput =
          document.createElement(
            "input"
          );


        searchInput.type =
          "search";


        searchInput.className =
          "assist-search";


        searchInput.placeholder =
          placeholder;


        searchInput.autocomplete =
          "off";


        searchWrap.appendChild(
          searchInput
        );


        assistBody.appendChild(
          searchWrap
        );


        const results =
          document.createElement(
            "div"
          );


        assistBody.appendChild(
          results
        );


        const render =
          () => {

            results.innerHTML =
              "";


            const search =
              normalizeAliasText(
                searchInput.value
              );


            const filtered =
              items.filter(
                item =>
                  !search ||
                  normalizeAliasText(
                    `${item.label} ${item.searchText || ""}`
                  ).includes(
                    search
                  )
              );


            if (
              !filtered.length
            ) {

              const empty =
                document.createElement(
                  "div"
                );


              empty.className =
                "assist-empty";


              empty.textContent =
                "No matching options were found.";


              results.appendChild(
                empty
              );


              return;

            }


            const renderGroups =
              groups ||
              [
                {
                  title:
                    "",

                  test:
                    () =>
                      true
                }
              ];


            renderGroups.forEach(
              group => {

                const groupItems =
                  filtered.filter(
                    group.test
                  );


                if (
                  !groupItems.length
                ) {

                  return;

                }


                if (
                  group.title
                ) {

                  const heading =
                    document.createElement(
                      "div"
                    );


                  heading.className =
                    "assist-group";


                  heading.textContent =
                    group.title;


                  results.appendChild(
                    heading
                  );

                }


                groupItems.forEach(
                  item => {

                    const button =
                      document.createElement(
                        "button"
                      );


                    button.type =
                      "button";


                    button.className =
                      "assist-choice";


                    button.textContent =
                      item.label;


                    button.addEventListener(
                      "click",
                      () =>
                        closeDriverAssist(
                          item.value
                        )
                    );


                    results.appendChild(
                      button
                    );

                  }
                );

              }
            );

          };


        searchInput.addEventListener(
          "input",
          render
        );


        render();


        setTimeout(
          () =>
            searchInput.focus(),
          50
        );

      }


      assistScreen.classList.add(
        "show"
      );

    }
  );

}


assistBackBtn?.addEventListener(
  "click",
  () =>
    closeDriverAssist(
      DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK
    )
);


assistSkipBtn.addEventListener(
  "click",
  () =>
    closeDriverAssist(
      null
    )
);


function contractIsAvailableForDriverAssist(
  contract
) {

  if (
    !contract ||
    contract.voided ===
      true
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const status =
    normalizeAliasText(
      contract.status
    );


  if (
    status ===
      "completed" ||
    status ===
      "voided" ||
    status ===
      "closed"
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const openBushels =
    Number(
      contract.openBushels
    );


  if (
    Number.isFinite(
      openBushels
    )
  ) {

    return openBushels >
      0;

  }


  const contractBushels =
    Number(
      contract.contractBushels
    );


  const deliveredBushels =
    Number(
      contract.deliveredBushels ||
      0
    );


  if (
    Number.isFinite(
      contractBushels
    )
  ) {

    return (
      contractBushels -
      (
        Number.isFinite(
          deliveredBushels
        )
          ? deliveredBushels
          : 0
      )
    ) >
      0;

  }


  return true;

}


function getDriverAssistCustomers(
  grainTicket,
  location,
  buyer,
  haulingJob =
    null
) {

  if (
    !grainTicket?.crop
  ) {

    return [];

  }


  const crop =
    normalizeMatchText(
      grainTicket.crop
    );


  const ids =
    new Set();


  /*
    ============================================================
    PREFERRED PATH:
    A hauling job is already known.

    In that case, Sold Under comes ONLY from OPEN contracts
    linked to that exact hauling job.
    ============================================================
  */

  if (
    haulingJob?.id
  ) {

    contracts.forEach(
      contract => {

        if (
          !contractIsAvailableForDriverAssist(
            contract
          )
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const contractHaulingJobId =
          String(
            contract?.haulingJobId ||
            ""
          ).trim();


        if (
          contractHaulingJobId !==
            String(
              haulingJob.id
            ).trim()
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const contractCrop =
          normalizeMatchText(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "crop",
                "commodity"
              ]
            )
          );


        if (
          crop &&
          contractCrop &&
          crop !==
            contractCrop
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const customerId =
          String(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "customerId",
                "grainCustomerId"
              ]
            ) ||
            ""
          ).trim();


        if (
          customerId
        ) {

          ids.add(
            customerId
          );

        }

      }
    );

  }
  else {

    /*
      ============================================================
      FALLBACK PATH:
      Hauling job is still unresolved.

      Preserve the old safe narrowing by:
        destination + buyer + crop

      This prevents Driver Assist from becoming unusable when the
      office hauling job could not be auto-assigned yet.
      ============================================================
    */

    if (
      !location
    ) {

      return [];

    }


    const locationId =
      String(
        location.id ||
        ""
      );


    const buyerId =
      String(
        buyer?.id ||
        location.buyerId ||
        ""
      );


    contracts.forEach(
      contract => {

        if (
          !contractIsAvailableForDriverAssist(
            contract
          )
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const contractCrop =
          normalizeMatchText(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "crop",
                "commodity"
              ]
            )
          );


        if (
          crop &&
          contractCrop &&
          crop !==
            contractCrop
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const contractLocationId =
          String(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "deliveryLocationId",
                "locationId"
              ]
            ) ||
            ""
          );


        const contractBuyerId =
          String(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "buyerId",
                "grainBuyerId"
              ]
            ) ||
            ""
          );


        if (
          locationId &&
          contractLocationId &&
          contractLocationId !==
            locationId
        ) {

          return;

        }


        if (
          buyerId &&
          contractBuyerId &&
          contractBuyerId !==
            buyerId
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const customerId =
          String(
            firstExistingValue(
              contract,
              [
                "customerId",
                "grainCustomerId"
              ]
            ) ||
            ""
          );


        if (
          customerId
        ) {

          ids.add(
            customerId
          );

        }

      }
    );

  }


  /*
    Return unique FarmVista customers.
  */

  return customers
    .filter(
      customer =>
        ids.has(
          String(
            customer.id
          )
        )
    )
    .sort(
      (
        a,
        b
      ) =>
        getCustomerName(
          a
        ).localeCompare(
          getCustomerName(
            b
          ),
          undefined,
          {
            numeric:
              true,

            sensitivity:
              "base"
          }
        )
    );

}


function buildDriverAssistBinSiteChoices(
  crop
) {

  const wantedCrop =
    normalizeMatchText(
      crop
    );


  const choices =
    [];


  binSites.forEach(
    site => {

      const status =
        normalizeAliasText(
          site.status ||
          "active"
        );


      if (
        status &&
        status !==
          "active"
      ) {

        return;

      }


      const siteName =
        String(
          site.name ||
          `Bin Site ${String(site.id).slice(0,6)}`
        ).trim();


      const bins =
        Array.isArray(
          site.bins
        )
          ? site.bins
          : [];


      const matchingBins =
        bins
          .map(
            (
              bin,
              index
            ) => ({
              bin,
              index,
              onHand:
                Number(
                  bin?.onHand ||
                  0
                ),
              crop:
                normalizeMatchText(
                  bin?.lastCropType ||
                  bin?.crop ||
                  bin?.cropType
                )
            })
          )
          .filter(
            item =>
              Number.isFinite(
                item.onHand
              ) &&
              item.onHand >
                0 &&
              item.crop &&
              item.crop ===
                wantedCrop
          );


      if (
        !matchingBins.length
      ) {

        return;

      }


      /*
        Driver only knows the SITE.

        Use the first bin at that site that contains this crop.
        This preserves the existing downstream inventory-posting
        shape, which expects siteId + binIndex/binNumber.
      */

      const selectedBin =
        matchingBins[0];


      choices.push({
        type:
          "bin_site",

        label:
          siteName,

        searchText:
          `${siteName} ${crop}`,

        value: {
          type:
            "bin",

          sourceScope:
            "site",

          siteId:
            site.id,

          siteName,

          binIndex:
            selectedBin.index,

          binNumber:
            selectedBin.bin?.num ??
            (
              selectedBin.index +
              1
            ),

          fieldId:
            String(
              site.fieldId ||
              site.farmFieldId ||
              site.field?.id ||
              ""
            ).trim() ||
            null,

          fieldName:
            String(
              site.fieldName ||
              site.farmFieldName ||
              site.field?.name ||
              ""
            ).trim() ||
            null,

          crop:
            crop
        }
      });

    }
  );


  return choices.sort(
    (
      a,
      b
    ) =>
      a.label.localeCompare(
        b.label,
        undefined,
        {
          numeric:
            true,

          sensitivity:
            "base"
        }
      )
  );

}


function grainBagEventHasRemainingInventory(
  event
) {

  const type =
    normalizeAliasText(
      event?.type
    );


  if (
    type !==
      "putdown" &&
    type !==
      "put down"
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const status =
    normalizeAliasText(
      event?.status
    );


  if (
    status ===
      "pickedup" ||
    status ===
      "picked up"
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const counts =
    event?.counts ||
    {};


  const full =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Number(
        counts.full ||
        0
      ) ||
      0
    );


  const partial =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Number(
        counts.partial ||
        0
      ) ||
      0
    );


  const partialFeetValues =
    Array.isArray(
      event.partialFeet
    )
      ? event.partialFeet
      : Array.isArray(
          counts.partialFeet
        )
        ? counts.partialFeet
        : [];


  const partialFeet =
    partialFeetValues.reduce(
      (
        total,
        value
      ) =>
        total +
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            value
          ) ||
          0
        ),
      0
    );


  return (
    full >
      0 ||
    partial >
      0 ||
    partialFeet >
      0
  );

}


function buildDriverAssistBagSiteChoices(
  crop
) {

  const wantedCrop =
    normalizeMatchText(
      crop
    );


  const grouped =
    new Map();


  grainBagEvents
    .filter(
      grainBagEventHasRemainingInventory
    )
    .filter(
      event =>
        normalizeMatchText(
          event.cropType ||
          event.crop
        ) ===
          wantedCrop
    )
    .forEach(
      event => {

        const fieldId =
          String(
            event.field?.id ||
            ""
          ).trim();


        const fieldName =
          String(
            event.field?.name ||
            ""
          ).trim();


        if (
          !fieldName
        ) {

          return;

        }


        const key =
          fieldId ||
          normalizeAliasText(
            fieldName
          );


        if (
          !grouped.has(
            key
          )
        ) {

          grouped.set(
            key,
            {
              fieldId:
                fieldId ||
                null,

              fieldName,

              events:
                []
            }
          );

        }


        grouped.get(
          key
        ).events.push(
          event
        );

      }
    );


  return Array.from(
    grouped.values()
  )
    .map(
      group => {

        /*
          Driver chooses the bag SITE only.
          Use the first currently open putDown event at that site.
        */

        const selectedEvent =
          group.events[0];


        return {
          type:
            "grain_bag_site",

          label:
            group.fieldName,

          searchText:
            `${group.fieldName} ${crop}`,

          value: {
            type:
              "grain_bag",

            sourceScope:
              "site",

            id:
              selectedEvent.id,

            bagEventId:
              selectedEvent.id,

            fieldId:
              group.fieldId,

            fieldName:
              group.fieldName,

            siteName:
              group.fieldName,

            cropYear:
              selectedEvent.cropYear ??
              null,

            crop:
              crop
          }
        };

      }
    )
    .sort(
      (
        a,
        b
      ) =>
        a.label.localeCompare(
          b.label,
          undefined,
          {
            numeric:
              true,

            sensitivity:
              "base"
          }
        )
    );

}


function haulingJobIsActive(
  job
) {

  if (
    !job ||
    job.active === false ||
    job.isActive === false
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const status =
    normalizeAliasText(
      job.status ||
      "active"
    );


  if (
    status.includes(
      "closed"
    ) ||
    status.includes(
      "complete"
    ) ||
    status.includes(
      "cancel"
    ) ||
    status.includes(
      "void"
    )
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  const starting =
    haulingJobStartingBushels(
      job
    );


  if (
    starting >
      0 &&
    haulingJobRemainingBushels(
      job
    ) <=
      0.005
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  return true;

}


function haulingJobLocationId(
  job
) {

  return String(
    job?.deliveryLocationId ||
    job?.locationId ||
    job?.destinationId ||
    ""
  ).trim();

}


function haulingJobCustomerId(
  job
) {

  return String(
    job?.customerId ||
    job?.grainCustomerId ||
    ""
  ).trim();

}


function haulingJobCrop(
  job
) {

  return normalizeScannedCrop(
    job?.crop ||
    job?.commodity
  );

}


function haulingJobStartingBushels(
  job
) {

  const value =
    Number(
      job?.startingBushels ??
      job?.jobBushels ??
      job?.bushels ??
      0
    );


  return Number.isFinite(
    value
  )
    ? Math.max(
        0,
        value
      )
    : 0;

}


function haulingJobTicketedBushels(
  job
) {

  const jobId =
    String(
      job?.id ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  if (
    !jobId
  ) {

    return 0;

  }


  return grainTickets
    .filter(
      ticket => {

        const status =
          normalizeAliasText(
            ticket?.status ||
            ""
          );


        const voided =
          ticket?.voided ===
            true ||
          status.includes(
            "void"
          );


        const ticketJobId =
          String(
            ticket?.haulingJobId ||
            ticket?.grainHaulingJobId ||
            ""
          ).trim();


        return (
          !voided &&
          ticketJobId ===
            jobId
        );

      }
    )
    .reduce(
      (
        total,
        ticket
      ) => {

        const bushels =
          Number(
            ticket?.netBushels ??
            ticket?.netBu ??
            ticket?.bushels ??
            0
          );


        return total +
          (
            Number.isFinite(
              bushels
            )
              ? bushels
              : 0
          );

      },
      0
    );

}


function haulingJobRemainingBushels(
  job
) {

  return Math.max(
    0,
    haulingJobStartingBushels(
      job
    ) -
    haulingJobTicketedBushels(
      job
    )
  );

}


function normalizedTicketDateISO(
  value
) {

  const raw =
    String(
      value ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  if (
    !raw
  ) {

    return "";

  }


  if (
    /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(
      raw
    )
  ) {

    return raw;

  }


  const usMatch =
    raw.match(
      /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/
    );


  if (
    usMatch
  ) {

    return [
      usMatch[3],

      String(
        usMatch[1]
      ).padStart(
        2,
        "0"
      ),

      String(
        usMatch[2]
      ).padStart(
        2,
        "0"
      )
    ].join(
      "-"
    );

  }


  const parsed =
    new Date(
      raw
    );


  if (
    Number.isNaN(
      parsed.getTime()
    )
  ) {

    return "";

  }


  return [
    parsed.getFullYear(),

    String(
      parsed.getMonth() +
      1
    ).padStart(
      2,
      "0"
    ),

    String(
      parsed.getDate()
    ).padStart(
      2,
      "0"
    )
  ].join(
    "-"
  );

}


function haulingJobMatchesTicketDate(
  job,
  ticketDate
) {

  const date =
    normalizedTicketDateISO(
      ticketDate
    );


  if (
    !date
  ) {

    return true;

  }


  const start =
    normalizedTicketDateISO(
      job?.deliveryStartDate ||
      job?.startDate
    );


  const end =
    normalizedTicketDateISO(
      job?.deliveryEndDate ||
      job?.endDate
    );


  if (
    start &&
    date <
      start
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  if (
    end &&
    date >
      end
  ) {

    return false;

  }


  return true;

}


function matchingActiveHaulingJobsForTicket(
  grainTicket,
  customer = null,
  locationOverride = null,
  buyerOverride = null
) {

  const crop =
    normalizeScannedCrop(
      grainTicket?.crop
    );

  if (!crop) {
    return [];
  }

  const locationMatch =
    findDeliveryLocationMatch(
      grainTicket
    );

  const matchedLocation =
    locationOverride ||
    (
      locationMatch?.matched
        ? locationMatch.location
        : null
    );

  const matchedLocationId =
    String(
      matchedLocation?.id ||
      ""
    ).trim();

  const matchedBuyerId =
    String(
      buyerOverride?.id ||
      matchedLocation?.buyerId ||
      ""
    ).trim();

  const customerId =
    String(
      customer?.id ||
      ""
    ).trim();

  let matches =
    haulingJobs
      .filter(
        haulingJobIsActive
      )
      .filter(
        job =>
          haulingJobCrop(job) === crop
      )
      .filter(
        job =>
          haulingJobMatchesTicketDate(
            job,
            grainTicket?.ticketDate
          )
      );

  if (matchedLocationId) {
    matches =
      matches.filter(
        job =>
          haulingJobLocationId(job) ===
            matchedLocationId
      );
  }

  /*
    Sold Under and Hauling Job work in both directions.
