    Once Sold Under is known, keep only jobs with an OPEN linked
    contract for that customer and crop.
  */
  if (customerId) {
    matches =
      matches.filter(
        job =>
          contracts.some(
            contract => {
              if (!contractIsAvailableForDriverAssist(contract)) {
                return false;
              }

              const contractJobId =
                String(
                  contract?.haulingJobId ||
                  ""
                ).trim();

              const contractCustomerId =
                String(
                  firstExistingValue(
                    contract,
                    ["customerId", "grainCustomerId"]
                  ) ||
                  ""
                ).trim();

              const contractCrop =
                normalizeScannedCrop(
                  firstExistingValue(
                    contract,
                    ["crop", "commodity"]
                  )
                );

              const contractLocationId =
                String(
                  firstExistingValue(
                    contract,
                    [
                      "deliveryLocationId",
                      "locationId",
                      "destinationId"
                    ]
                  ) ||
                  ""
                ).trim();

              const contractBuyerId =
                String(
                  firstExistingValue(
                    contract,
                    ["buyerId", "elevatorId"]
                  ) ||
                  ""
                ).trim();

              return (
                contractJobId === String(job.id || "").trim() &&
                contractCustomerId === customerId &&
                (!contractCrop || contractCrop === crop) &&
                (
                  !matchedLocationId ||
                  !contractLocationId ||
                  contractLocationId === matchedLocationId
                ) &&
                (
                  !matchedBuyerId ||
                  !contractBuyerId ||
                  contractBuyerId === matchedBuyerId
                )
              );
            }
          )
      );
  }

  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Hauling job candidates:",
    {
      crop,
      ticketDate: grainTicket?.ticketDate || null,
      destinationId: matchedLocationId || null,
      soldUnderId: customerId || null,
      count: matches.length,
      jobs: matches.map(
        job => ({
          id: job.id,
          label: haulingJobDisplayLabel(job).label,
          locationId: haulingJobLocationId(job)
        })
      )
    }
  );

  return matches;
}


function automaticHaulingJobForTicket(
  grainTicket,
  customer = null,
  locationOverride = null,
  buyerOverride = null
) {
  const matches =
    matchingActiveHaulingJobsForTicket(
      grainTicket,
      customer,
      locationOverride,
      buyerOverride
    );

  return matches.length === 1
    ? matches[0]
    : null;
}


function haulingJobDisplayLabel(
  job
) {

  const location =
    deliveryLocations.find(
      item =>
        item.id ===
        haulingJobLocationId(
          job
        )
    ) ||
    null;


  const buyerName =
    String(
      job?.buyerName ||
      location?.buyerName ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const locationName =
    String(
      job?.deliveryLocationName ||
      job?.locationName ||
      job?.destinationName ||
      location?.locationName ||
      "Hauling Job"
    ).trim();


  const destination =
    buyerName &&
    !cleanCompare(
      locationName
    ).startsWith(
      cleanCompare(
        buyerName
      )
    )
      ? `${buyerName} ${locationName}`
      : locationName;


  const start =
    String(
      job?.deliveryStartDate ||
      job?.startDate ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const end =
    String(
      job?.deliveryEndDate ||
      job?.endDate ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const dateText =
    start || end
      ? `${start || "?"} to ${end || "?"}`
      : "";


  return {
    label:
      `${destination} — ${haulingJobStartingBushels(job).toLocaleString("en-US")} bu`,

    searchText:
      `${destination} ${buyerName} ${haulingJobCrop(job) || ""} ${dateText}`,

    detail:
      `${dateText ? `${dateText} • ` : ""}Remaining ${haulingJobRemainingBushels(job).toLocaleString("en-US")} bu`
  };

}


function activeHaulingJobChoices(
  grainTicket =
    null
) {

  const jobs =
    grainTicket
      ? matchingActiveHaulingJobsForTicket(
          grainTicket
        )
      : haulingJobs.filter(
          haulingJobIsActive
        );


  return jobs
    .map(
      job => {

        const display =
          haulingJobDisplayLabel(
            job
          );


        return {
          label:
            `${display.label} • ${display.detail}`,

          searchText:
            display.searchText,

          value:
            job
        };

      }
    )
    .sort(
      (
        a,
        b
      ) =>
        a.label.localeCompare(
          b.label,
          undefined,
          {
            numeric:
              true,

            sensitivity:
              "base"
          }
        )
    );

}


function rebuildMatchingAfterDriverAssist(
  grainTicket,
  haulingJob,
  location,
  buyer,
  customer,
  source,
  previousMatching,
  skippedReasons
) {

  const locationMatch =
    location
      ? {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            previousMatching?.locationMatch?.location?.id ===
              location.id
              ? previousMatching.locationMatch.matchType
              : "driver_selected",

          location
        }
      : {
          matched:
            false,

          matchType:
            null,

          location:
            null
        };


  const buyerMatch =
    buyer
      ? {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            previousMatching?.buyerMatch?.buyer?.id ===
              buyer.id
              ? previousMatching.buyerMatch.matchType
              : "location_buyer",

          buyer
        }
      : {
          matched:
            false,

          matchType:
            null,

          buyer:
            null
        };


  const customerMatch =
    customer
      ? {
          matched:
            true,

          matchType:
            previousMatching?.customerMatch?.customer?.id ===
              customer.id
              ? previousMatching.customerMatch.matchType
              : "driver_selected",

          customer
        }
      : {
          matched:
            false,

          matchType:
            null,

          customer:
            null
        };


  const reviewReasons =
    [];


  if (
    !haulingJob
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "hauling_job_not_assigned"
    );

  }


  if (
    !location
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "delivery_location_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !buyer
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "buyer_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !customer
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "customer_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !source
  ) {

    reviewReasons.push(
      "grain_source_not_assigned"
    );

  }


  reviewReasons.push(
    ...(
      Array.isArray(
        skippedReasons
      )
        ? skippedReasons
        : []
    )
  );


  const uniqueReviewReasons =
    Array.from(
      new Set(
        reviewReasons
      )
    );


  return {
    ...previousMatching,

    locationMatch,

    buyerMatch,

    customerMatch,

    validationStatus:
      uniqueReviewReasons.length
        ? "needs_review"
        : "verified",

    reviewReasons:
      uniqueReviewReasons,

    grainSource:
      source ||
      null,

    haulingJob:
      haulingJob ||
      null
  };

}


async function askDriverForGrainSource(
  crop
) {

  while (
    crop
  ) {

    const sourceType =
      await askDriverButtons({
        step:
          "Grain Source",

        title:
          `Where did this load of ${crop} come from?`,

        text:
          "Choose the source the driver knows. If you open the wrong section, use Back.",

        choices: [
          {
            label:
              "Active Field Harvest",

            value:
              "active_field_harvest"
          },
          {
            label:
              "Field",

            value:
              "field"
          },
          {
            label:
              "Grain Storage",

            value:
              "storage"
          }
        ],

        allowSkip:
          true,

        allowBack:
          false
      });


    if (
      !sourceType
    ) {

      return null;

    }


    if (
      sourceType ===
        "active_field_harvest"
    ) {

      return {

        type:
          "active_field_harvest",

        sourceScope:
          "active_harvest",

        id:
          null,

        siteId:
          null,

        siteName:
          "Active Field Harvest",

        fieldId:
          null,

        fieldName:
          null,

        crop,

        bypassInventory:
          true

      };

    }


    if (
      sourceType ===
        "field"
    ) {

      const selectedField =
        await askDriverSearchList({
          step:
            "Grain Source",

          title:
            `Which field did this ${crop} come from?`,

          text:
            "Choose the actual field this grain came from.",

          placeholder:
            "Search field name or number…",

          items:
            fields.map(
              field => ({
                label:
                  String(
                    field.name ||
                    ""
                  ).trim(),

                searchText:
                  `${field.name || ""} ${field.farmName || ""} ${field.farmId || ""}`,

                value:
                  field
              })
            ),

          allowSkip:
            false,

          allowBack:
            true
        });


      if (
        selectedField ===
          DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK
      ) {

        continue;

      }


      if (
        !selectedField
      ) {

        return null;

      }


      /*
        A selected field is part of Active Harvest, not a separate
        inventory source type. Keep the field identity on the ticket
        while using active_field_harvest so the Grain Inventory page
        can roll the load into Active Harvest and still drill down by field.
      */
      return {
        type:
          "active_field_harvest",

        sourceScope:
          "field",

        id:
          selectedField.id,

        fieldId:
          selectedField.id,

        fieldName:
          String(
            selectedField.name ||
            ""
          ).trim(),

        siteName:
          String(
            selectedField.name ||
            ""
          ).trim(),

        crop,

        /*
          A field is a tracking source only.
          It must never block the scan because there is no
          bin/bag inventory balance to deduct from.
        */
        bypassInventory:
          true
      };

    }


    if (
      sourceType ===
        "storage"
    ) {

      const binChoices =
        buildDriverAssistBinSiteChoices(
          crop
        );


      const bagChoices =
        buildDriverAssistBagSiteChoices(
          crop
        );


      const selectedStorage =
        await askDriverSearchList({
          step:
            "Grain Source",

          title:
            `Which grain storage site did this ${crop} come from?`,

          text:
            "Only sites with this crop currently available are shown. Drivers choose the site, not an individual bin or bag.",

          placeholder:
            "Search grain storage site…",

          items: [
            ...binChoices,
            ...bagChoices
          ],

          groups: [
            {
              title:
                "Grain Bin Sites",

              test:
                item =>
                  item.type ===
                    "bin_site"
            },
            {
              title:
                "Grain Bag Sites",

              test:
                item =>
                  item.type ===
                    "grain_bag_site"
            }
          ],

          allowSkip:
            false,

          allowBack:
            true
        });


      if (
        selectedStorage ===
          DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK
      ) {

        continue;

      }


      if (
        !selectedStorage
      ) {

        return null;

      }


      return selectedStorage;

    }

  }


  return null;

}


async function runDriverAssistQuestions(
  grainTicket,
  ocrResult,
  matching
) {

  if (isGuestScan) {
    return matching;
  }

  const skippedReasons = [];

  let source = null;
  let haulingJob = null;
  let location = matching?.locationMatch?.location || null;
  let buyer = matching?.buyerMatch?.buyer || null;

  /*
    Sold Under is ticket truth and does not require a hauling job.
    Keep a confident OCR customer match while the hauling job is unresolved.
  */
  let customer = matching?.customerMatch?.customer || null;

  let crop =
    normalizeScannedCrop(
      grainTicket.crop
    );

  processingScreen.classList.remove("show");

  /* ========================================================
     GRAIN SOURCE
  ======================================================== */
  if (crop) {
    source =
      await askDriverForGrainSource(crop);

    if (!source) {
      skippedReasons.push("grain_source_not_selected");
    }
  }
  else {
    skippedReasons.push("grain_source_not_selected");
  }

  /* ========================================================
     DESTINATION
  ======================================================== */
  while (!location) {
    const selectedLocation =
      await askDriverSearchList({
        step: "Destination",
        title: "Where was this load delivered?",
        text: "FarmVista could not confidently match the destination from the scale ticket.",
        placeholder: "Search elevator, location, or city…",
        items:
          deliveryLocations
            .map(
              item => ({
                label:
                  [
                    item.buyerName,
                    getLocationName(item),
                    [
                      getLocationCity(item),
                      getLocationState(item)
                    ]
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .join(", ")
                  ]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" — "),
                searchText:
                  [
                    item.buyerName,
                    getLocationName(item),
                    getLocationStreet(item),
                    getLocationCity(item),
                    getLocationState(item),
                    getLocationZip(item)
                  ]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" "),
                value: item
              })
            )
            .sort(
              (a, b) =>
                a.label.localeCompare(
                  b.label,
                  undefined,
                  {
                    numeric: true,
                    sensitivity: "base"
                  }
                )
            ),
        allowSkip: true,
        allowBack: true
      });

    if (selectedLocation === DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK) {
      if (crop) {
        const correctedSource =
          await askDriverForGrainSource(crop);

        if (correctedSource) {
          source = correctedSource;
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (!selectedLocation) {
      skippedReasons.push("delivery_location_not_selected");
      break;
    }

    location = selectedLocation;

    buyer =
      buyers.find(
        item =>
          String(item.id) ===
            String(selectedLocation.buyerId || "")
      ) ||
      null;

    const originalEvidence =
      buildLocationAliasText(grainTicket);

    ocrResult.manualCorrections = {
      ...(ocrResult.manualCorrections || {}),
      destination: {
        originalValue: originalEvidence || null,
        selectedId: selectedLocation.id,
        selectedValue: getLocationName(selectedLocation),
        source: "driver_selection",
        learningEligible: Boolean(originalEvidence),
        learningReason:
          originalEvidence
            ? "ocr_evidence_confirmed"
            : "driver_supplied_missing_value"
      }
    };
  }

  if (location && !buyer) {
    buyer =
      buyers.find(
        item =>
          String(item.id) ===
            String(location.buyerId || "")
      ) ||
      null;
  }

  /* ========================================================
     SOLD UNDER — INDEPENDENT OF HAULING JOB
  ======================================================== */
  if (location && buyer && !customer) {
    const refreshedCustomerMatch =
      findCustomerMatch(
        grainTicket,
        {
          matched: true,
          matchType: "driver_or_ocr_destination",
          location
        },
        {
          matched: true,
          matchType: "location_buyer",
          buyer
        }
      );

    customer =
      refreshedCustomerMatch.customer || null;
  }

  const baseHaulingJobs =
    matchingActiveHaulingJobsForTicket(
      grainTicket,
      null,
      location,
      buyer
    );

  const uniqueContextJob =
    baseHaulingJobs.length === 1
      ? baseHaulingJobs[0]
      : null;

  if (!customer && location && grainTicket?.crop) {
    const eligibleCustomers =
      getDriverAssistCustomers(
        grainTicket,
        location,
        buyer,
        uniqueContextJob
      );

    if (eligibleCustomers.length === 1) {
      customer = eligibleCustomers[0];
    }
    else if (eligibleCustomers.length > 1) {
      const selectedCustomer =
        await askDriverSearchList({
          step: "Sold Under",
          title: "Who is this load sold under?",
          text:
            uniqueContextJob
              ? "Choose the Sold Under customer from the open contracts linked to this hauling job."
              : `Choose the Sold Under customer for this ${grainTicket.crop} delivery.`,
          placeholder: "Search Sold Under…",
          items: [
            ...eligibleCustomers.map(
              item => ({
                label: getCustomerName(item),
                searchText: getCustomerName(item),
                value: item
              })
            ),
            {
              label: "Unknown / I'm not sure",
              searchText: "unknown not sure don't know",
              value: "__unknown_sold_under__"
            }
          ],
          allowSkip: true,
          allowBack: true
        });

      if (selectedCustomer === DRIVER_ASSIST_BACK) {
        if (crop) {
          const correctedSource =
            await askDriverForGrainSource(crop);
          if (correctedSource) {
            source = correctedSource;
          }
        }
      }
      else if (
        selectedCustomer === "__unknown_sold_under__"
      ) {
        customer = null;
        skippedReasons.push("sold_under_unknown");

        ocrResult.manualCorrections = {
          ...(ocrResult.manualCorrections || {}),
          customer: {
            originalValue:
              String(grainTicket.customerText || "").trim() || null,
            selectedId: null,
            selectedValue: "Unknown",
            source: "driver_unknown",
            learningEligible: false,
            learningReason: "driver_could_not_identify_sold_under"
          }
        };
      }
      else if (selectedCustomer) {
        customer = selectedCustomer;

        const originalEvidence =
          String(
            grainTicket.customerText ||
            ""
          ).trim();

        ocrResult.manualCorrections = {
          ...(ocrResult.manualCorrections || {}),
          customer: {
            originalValue: originalEvidence || null,
            selectedId: selectedCustomer.id,
            selectedValue: getCustomerName(selectedCustomer),
            source: "driver_selection",
            learningEligible: Boolean(originalEvidence),
            learningReason:
              originalEvidence
                ? "ocr_evidence_confirmed"
                : "driver_supplied_missing_value"
          }
        };
      }
      else {
        skippedReasons.push("sold_under_driver_skipped");
      }
    }
  }

  /* ========================================================
     HAULING JOB — NARROWED BY SOLD UNDER WHEN KNOWN
  ======================================================== */
  haulingJob =
    automaticHaulingJobForTicket(
      grainTicket,
      customer,
      location,
      buyer
    );

  if (haulingJob) {
    const jobCrop = haulingJobCrop(haulingJob);
    crop = jobCrop || crop;

    if (crop) {
      grainTicket.crop = crop;
    }

    ocrResult.driverContext = {
      ...(ocrResult.driverContext || {}),
      haulingJob: {
        id: haulingJob.id,
        name: haulingJobDisplayLabel(haulingJob).label,
        source:
          customer?.id
            ? "automatic_crop_destination_sold_under_match"
            : "automatic_crop_destination_match"
      }
    };
  }
  else {
    skippedReasons.push("hauling_job_not_auto_assigned");
  }

  if (
    !customer &&
    !skippedReasons.includes("customer_not_selected")
  ) {
    skippedReasons.push("customer_not_selected");
  }

  if (source) {
    ocrResult.driverContext = {
      ...(ocrResult.driverContext || {}),
      grainSource: {
        ...source,
        source: "driver_selection",
        learningEligible: false,
        learningReason: "operational_context_not_ocr_field"
      }
    };
  }

  showProcessing("Finishing grain ticket…");

  return rebuildMatchingAfterDriverAssist(
    grainTicket,
    haulingJob,
    location,
    buyer,
    customer,
    source,
    matching,
    skippedReasons
  );
}


// ==========================================================
// SAVE SCANNED GRAIN TICKET
// ==========================================================

async function findDuplicateGrainTicket(
  grainTicket,
  matching
) {

  const ticketNumber =
    String(
      grainTicket?.ticketNumber ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  if (
    !ticketNumber
  ) {

    return null;

  }


  const buyer =
    matching?.buyerMatch?.buyer ||
    null;


  const buyerId =
    String(
      buyer?.id ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  /*
    BEST CHECK:
    Same FarmVista buyer/elevator ID
    AND same ticket number.
  */

  if (
    buyerId
  ) {

    const duplicateQuery =
      query(
        collection(
          db,
          TICKET_COLLECTION
        ),
        where(
          "buyerId",
          "==",
          buyerId
        ),
        where(
          "ticketNumber",
          "==",
          ticketNumber
        )
      );


    const snapshot =
      await getDocs(
        duplicateQuery
      );


    if (
      !snapshot.empty
    ) {

      return {
        id:
          snapshot.docs[0].id,

        ...snapshot.docs[0].data()
      };

    }

  }


  /*
    FALLBACK CHECK:

    If FarmVista could not match the elevator to a buyer,
    compare the OCR elevator wording and ticket number.

    We load tickets with the same ticket number and then
    normalize the elevator names in JavaScript so differences
    in capitalization/punctuation do not matter.
  */

  const elevatorName =
    normalizeMatchText(
      grainTicket?.elevatorName
    );


  if (
    !elevatorName
  ) {

    return null;

  }


  const ticketQuery =
    query(
      collection(
        db,
        TICKET_COLLECTION
      ),
      where(
        "ticketNumber",
        "==",
        ticketNumber
      )
    );


  const snapshot =
    await getDocs(
      ticketQuery
    );


  const duplicate =
    snapshot.docs.find(
      docSnapshot => {

        const data =
          docSnapshot.data() ||
          {};


        const existingElevator =
          normalizeMatchText(
            data.ocrElevatorName ||
            data.buyerName ||
            ""
          );


        return (
          existingElevator &&
          existingElevator ===
            elevatorName
        );

      }
    );


  if (
    !duplicate
  ) {

    return null;

  }


  return {
    id:
      duplicate.id,

    ...duplicate.data()
  };

}


function safeFilePart(
  value
) {

  return String(
    value ?? ""
  )
    .trim()
    .replace(
      /[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g,
      "-"
    )
    .replace(
      /^-+|-+$/g,
      ""
    ) ||
    "ticket";

}


async function uploadGrainTicketImage(
  file,
  grainTicket
) {

  if (
    !file
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "The grain ticket image is missing."
    );

  }


  const ticketNumber =
    safeFilePart(
      grainTicket?.ticketNumber
    );


  const ticketDate =
    safeFilePart(
      grainTicket?.ticketDate
    );


  const elevator =
    safeFilePart(
      grainTicket?.elevatorName ||
      "elevator"
    );


  /*
    IMPORTANT:

    Do NOT use Date.now() in this filename.

    The same elevator + date + ticket number always gets
    the same Storage path.

    That means a retry overwrites/reuses the same image
    instead of creating ticket-123-111.jpg,
    ticket-123-222.jpg, ticket-123-333.jpg, etc.
  */

  const imagePath =
    [
      "grain-tickets",
      ticketDate,
      `${elevator}-${ticketNumber}.jpg`
    ]
      .join(
        "/"
      );


  const imageRef =
    ref(
      storage,
      imagePath
    );


  await retryNetworkAction(
    () =>
      uploadBytes(
        imageRef,
        file,
        {
          contentType:
            file.type ||
            "image/jpeg",

          customMetadata: {

            ticketNumber:
              String(
                grainTicket?.ticketNumber ||
                ""
              ),

            ticketDate:
              String(
                grainTicket?.ticketDate ||
                ""
              ),

            crop:
              String(
                grainTicket?.crop ||
                ""
              )

          }
        }
      ),

    "Saving ticket image"
  );


  const imageUrl =
    await retryNetworkAction(
      () =>
        getDownloadURL(
          imageRef
        ),

      "Confirming ticket image"
    );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Image uploaded:",
    imagePath
  );


  return {
    imagePath,
    imageUrl
  };

}


// ==========================================================
// OCR MEMORY
// ==========================================================

function buildOcrMemoryProfileKey(
  grainTicket
) {

  /*
    This groups similar tickets together later.

    Examples:

      green_plains | green plains grain company llc | madison | il

      cahokia | cahokia grain | cahokia | il

    The key is NOT used to make matching decisions yet.
    It is simply stored so the future learning system has
    an easy way to group thousands of tickets.
  */

  const parts =
    [
      grainTicket?.parserProfile,
      grainTicket?.elevatorName,
      grainTicket?.deliveryCity,
      grainTicket?.deliveryState
    ]
      .map(
        value =>
          normalizeAliasText(
            value
          )
      )
      .filter(
        Boolean
      );


  return parts.length
    ? parts.join(
        " | "
      )
    : "unknown";

}


async function saveOcrMemoryRecord({
  savedTicketId,
  grainTicket,
  ocrResult,
  matching,
  image,
  employee,
  driverName
}) {

  if (
    !savedTicketId ||
    !grainTicket
  ) {

    return null;

  }


  const customer =
    matching?.customerMatch
      ?.customer ||
    null;


  const location =
    matching?.locationMatch
      ?.location ||
    null;


  const buyer =
    matching?.buyerMatch
      ?.buyer ||
    null;


  const manualCrop =
    ocrResult
      ?.manualCorrections
      ?.crop ||
    null;


  const manualDestination =
    ocrResult
      ?.manualCorrections
      ?.destination ||
    null;


  const manualCustomer =
    ocrResult
      ?.manualCorrections
      ?.customer ||
    null;


  const driverGrainSource =
    ocrResult
      ?.driverContext
      ?.grainSource ||
    matching?.grainSource ||
    null;


  const rawText =
    String(
      grainTicket.rawText ||
      ocrResult?.document?.text ||
      ""
    );


  const profileKey =
    buildOcrMemoryProfileKey(
      grainTicket
    );


  /*
    MEMORY RECORD DESIGN

    We intentionally keep THREE separate versions of reality:

      1. ocr
         What fvOcr actually returned.

      2. farmVistaMatch
         What FarmVista matched that OCR to.

      3. savedValues
         What was ultimately written to grain_tickets.

    Later, when the office corrects a ticket, we will add a
    FOURTH section:

      verifiedValues

    That distinction is what prevents FarmVista from learning
    its own mistakes.
  */

  const memoryPayload = {

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // MEMORY METADATA
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    memoryVersion:
      1,

    memoryType:
      "grain_ticket",

    source:
      "grain_ticket_scan",

    status:
      "observed",

    /*
      FALSE FOR NOW.

      We do not let fvOcr learn from this record until a future
      verification/correction workflow tells us the values are
      actually trustworthy.
    */

    verified:
      false,

    eligibleForLearning:
      false,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RELATION TO NORMAL GRAIN TICKET
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    ticketId:
      savedTicketId,

    ticketNumber:
      grainTicket.ticketNumber ||
      null,

    ticketDate:
      grainTicket.ticketDate ||
      null,

    ticketImagePath:
      image?.imagePath ||
      null,

    ticketImageUrl:
      image?.imageUrl ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // OCR PROFILE / ELEVATOR FAMILY
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    parserProfile:
      grainTicket.parserProfile ||
      null,

    profileKey:
      profileKey,

    elevatorFingerprint:
      normalizeAliasText(
        grainTicket.elevatorName
      ) ||
      null,

    cityFingerprint:
      normalizeAliasText(
        grainTicket.deliveryCity
      ) ||
      null,

    stateFingerprint:
      normalizeAliasText(
        grainTicket.deliveryState
      ) ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // RAW OCR RESULT
    //
    // This is what fvOcr actually thought it saw.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    ocr: {

      elevatorName:
        grainTicket.elevatorName ||
        null,

      deliveryStreet:
        grainTicket.deliveryStreet ||
        null,

      deliveryCity:
        grainTicket.deliveryCity ||
        null,

      deliveryState:
        grainTicket.deliveryState ||
        null,

      deliveryZip:
        grainTicket.deliveryZip ||
        null,


      customerText:
        grainTicket.customerText ||
        null,

      customerAccountText:
        grainTicket.customerAccountText ||
        null,


      ticketNumber:
        grainTicket.ticketNumber ||
        null,

      ticketDate:
        grainTicket.ticketDate ||
        null,

      crop:
        manualCrop
          ? manualCrop.originalValue ??
            null
          : grainTicket.crop ||
            null,


      grossWeight:
        grainTicket.grossWeight ??
        null,

      tareWeight:
        grainTicket.tareWeight ??
        null,

      netWeight:
        grainTicket.netWeight ??
        null,


      testWeight:
        grainTicket.testWeight ??
        null,

      moisture:
        grainTicket.moisture ??
        null,

      damage:
        grainTicket.damage ??
        null,

      foreignMaterial:
        grainTicket.foreignMaterial ??
        null,


      grossBushels:
        grainTicket.grossBushels ??
        null,

      shrinkBushels:
        grainTicket.shrinkBushels ??
        null,

      netBushels:
        grainTicket.netBushels ??
        null,


      vehicleId:
        grainTicket.vehicleId ||
        null,


      scanValid:
        ocrResult?.scanValid ===
        true,

      scanErrors:
        Array.isArray(
          ocrResult?.scanErrors
        )
          ? ocrResult.scanErrors
          : [],

      reviewWarnings:
        Array.isArray(
          ocrResult?.reviewWarnings
        )
          ? ocrResult.reviewWarnings
          : [],


      /*
        Keep the raw OCR text.

        This is extremely important because later we can compare:

          raw OCR
          parser result
          human verified result
      */

      rawText:
        rawText

    },


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // FARMVISTA MATCHING RESULT
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    farmVistaMatch: {

      buyerId:
        buyer?.id ||
        null,

      buyerName:
        buyer
          ? getBuyerName(
              buyer
            )
          : null,

      buyerMatchType:
        matching?.buyerMatch
          ?.matchType ||
        null,


      deliveryLocationId:
        location?.id ||
        null,

      deliveryLocationName:
        location
          ? getLocationName(
              location
            )
          : null,

      deliveryLocationMatchType:
        matching?.locationMatch
          ?.matchType ||
        null,


      customerId:
        customer?.id ||
        null,

      customerName:
        customer
          ? getCustomerName(
              customer
            )
          : null,

      customerMatchType:
        matching?.customerMatch
          ?.matchType ||
        null,


      validationStatus:
        matching?.validationStatus ||
        null,

      reviewReasons:
        Array.isArray(
          matching?.reviewReasons
        )
          ? matching.reviewReasons
          : []

    },


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // VALUES SAVED AT SCAN TIME
    //
    // These are NOT considered verified training truth yet.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    savedValues: {

      buyerId:
        buyer?.id ||
        null,

      buyerName:
        buyer
          ? getBuyerName(
              buyer
            )
          : null,


      deliveryLocationId:
        location?.id ||
        null,

      deliveryLocationName:
        location
          ? getLocationName(
              location
            )
          : null,

      deliveryStreet:
        location
          ? getLocationStreet(
              location
            ) || null
          : grainTicket.deliveryStreet ||
            null,

      deliveryCity:
        location
          ? getLocationCity(
              location
            ) || null
          : grainTicket.deliveryCity ||
            null,

      deliveryState:
        location
          ? getLocationState(
              location
            ) || null
          : grainTicket.deliveryState ||
            null,

      deliveryZip:
        location
          ? getLocationZip(
              location
            ) || null
          : grainTicket.deliveryZip ||
            null,


      customerId:
        customer?.id ||
        null,

      customerName:
        customer
          ? getCustomerName(
              customer
            )
          : grainTicket.customerText ||
            null,


      grainSourceType:
        driverGrainSource?.type ||
        null,

      grainSourceId:
        driverGrainSource?.id ||
        driverGrainSource?.siteId ||
        driverGrainSource?.fieldId ||
        null,

      grainSourceName:
        driverGrainSource?.siteName ||
        driverGrainSource?.fieldName ||
        null,


      crop:
        grainTicket.crop ||
        null,


      grossWeight:
        grainTicket.grossWeight ??
        null,

      tareWeight:
        grainTicket.tareWeight ??
        null,

      netWeight:
        grainTicket.netWeight ??
        null,


      testWeight:
        grainTicket.testWeight ??
        null,

      moisture:
        grainTicket.moisture ??
        null,

      damage:
        grainTicket.damage ??
        null,

      foreignMaterial:
        grainTicket.foreignMaterial ??
        null,


      grossBushels:
        grainTicket.grossBushels ??
        null,

      shrinkBushels:
        grainTicket.shrinkBushels ??
        null,

      netBushels:
        grainTicket.netBushels ??
        null

    },


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // HUMAN INPUT DURING SCAN
    //
    // Crop chooser is the first example.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    humanInput: {

      crop: {

        used:
          Boolean(
            manualCrop
          ),

        source:
          manualCrop
            ? "driver_selection"
            : null,

        originalValue:
          manualCrop
            ?.originalValue ??
          null,

        selectedValue:
          manualCrop
            ?.selectedValue ??
          null,

        learningEligible:
          Boolean(
            manualCrop &&
            String(
              manualCrop.originalValue ??
              ""
            ).trim()
          ),

        learningReason:
          manualCrop
            ? (
                String(
                  manualCrop.originalValue ??
                  ""
                ).trim()
                  ? "ocr_evidence_confirmed"
                  : "driver_supplied_missing_value"
              )
            : null

      },


      destination: {

        used:
          Boolean(
            manualDestination
          ),

        source:
          manualDestination
            ?.source ||
          null,

        originalValue:
          manualDestination
            ?.originalValue ??
          null,

        selectedId:
          manualDestination
            ?.selectedId ??
          null,

        selectedValue:
          manualDestination
            ?.selectedValue ??
          null,

        learningEligible:
          manualDestination
            ?.learningEligible ===
          true,

        learningReason:
          manualDestination
            ?.learningReason ||
          null

      },


      customer: {

        used:
          Boolean(
            manualCustomer
          ),

        source:
          manualCustomer
            ?.source ||
          null,

        originalValue:
          manualCustomer
            ?.originalValue ??
          null,

        selectedId:
          manualCustomer
            ?.selectedId ??
          null,

        selectedValue:
          manualCustomer
            ?.selectedValue ??
          null,

        learningEligible:
          manualCustomer
            ?.learningEligible ===
          true,

        learningReason:
          manualCustomer
            ?.learningReason ||
          null

      },


      grainSource:
        driverGrainSource
          ? {
              ...driverGrainSource,

              source:
                "driver_selection",

              learningEligible:
                false,

              learningReason:
                "operational_context_not_ocr_field"
            }
          : null

    },


    learningSignals: {

      crop: {
        ocrEvidence:
          manualCrop
            ?.originalValue ??
          grainTicket.crop ??
          null,

        confirmedValue:
          grainTicket.crop ||
          null,

        eligible:
          Boolean(
            manualCrop &&
            String(
              manualCrop.originalValue ??
              ""
            ).trim()
          )
      },

      destination: {
        ocrEvidence:
          (
            manualDestination
              ?.originalValue ??
            buildLocationAliasText(
              grainTicket
            )
          ) ||
          null,

        confirmedId:
          location?.id ||
          null,

        confirmedName:
          location
            ? getLocationName(
                location
              )
            : null,

        eligible:
          manualDestination
            ?.learningEligible ===
          true
      },

      customer: {
        ocrEvidence:
          manualCustomer
            ?.originalValue ??
          grainTicket.customerText ??
          null,

        confirmedId:
          customer?.id ||
          null,

        confirmedName:
          customer
            ? getCustomerName(
                customer
              )
            : null,

        eligible:
          manualCustomer
            ?.learningEligible ===
          true
      }

    },


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // FUTURE VERIFIED RESULT
    //
    // The office correction/review workflow will eventually
    // populate this.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    verifiedValues:
      null,

    verificationSource:
      null,

    verifiedByUid:
      null,

    verifiedAt:
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // WHO CREATED THIS MEMORY
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    createdByUid:
      signedInUser?.uid ||
      null,

    createdByEmployeeId:
      employee?.id ||
      null,

    createdByName:
      driverName ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // TIMESTAMPS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    createdAt:
      serverTimestamp(),

    updatedAt:
      serverTimestamp()

  };


  const memoryDoc =
    await addDoc(
      collection(
        db,
        OCR_MEMORY_COLLECTION
      ),
      memoryPayload
    );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] OCR memory saved:",
    {
      memoryId:
        memoryDoc.id,

      ticketId:
        savedTicketId,

      profileKey
    }
  );


  return {
    id:
      memoryDoc.id,

    profileKey
  };

}


      // ==========================================================
// SECURE GUEST / SMS GRAIN-TICKET SAVE
// ==========================================================

async function saveGuestScannedTicket(
  file,
  ocrResult
) {

  if (
    !guestToken
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "The guest grain-ticket link is missing."
    );

  }


  if (
    !file
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "The grain-ticket image is missing."
    );

  }


  if (
    !ocrResult?.grainTicket
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "FarmVista did not receive grain-ticket OCR data."
    );

  }


  if (
    !GUEST_GRAIN_TICKET_URL ||
    GUEST_GRAIN_TICKET_URL.includes(
      "PASTE_YOUR"
    )
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "The FarmVista guest grain-ticket service URL has not been configured."
    );

  }


  processingText.textContent =
    "Submitting grain ticket…";


  /*
    Guest drivers are not authenticated FarmVista users.

    Do NOT attempt to upload directly to Firebase Storage.

    Send the prepared image to the secure backend and let the
    Cloud Function upload it using Firebase Admin permissions.
  */

  const imageBase64 =
    await fileToBase64(
      file
    );


  if (
    !imageBase64
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "FarmVista could not prepare the grain-ticket image."
    );

  }


  const response =
    await fetch(
      GUEST_GRAIN_TICKET_URL,
      {

        method:
          "POST",

        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json"
        },

        body:
          JSON.stringify({

            token:
              guestToken,

            image: {

              content:
                imageBase64,

              mimeType:
                file.type ||
                "image/jpeg"

            },

            ocrResult:
              ocrResult

          })

      }
    );


  let result =
    null;


  try {

    result =
      await response.json();

  }
  catch (_) {

    result =
      null;

  }


  if (
    !response.ok ||
    result?.ok !==
      true
  ) {

    const message =

      result?.error ||

      (
        Array.isArray(
          result?.errors
        )
          ? result.errors.join(
              " "
            )
          : ""
      ) ||

      `FarmVista could not submit this grain ticket (${response.status}).`;


    throw new Error(
      message
    );

  }


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Guest ticket saved:",
    result
  );


  return {

    id:
      result.ticketId ||
      null,

    loadId:
      result.loadId ||
      null,

    loadNumber:
      result.loadNumber ||
      null,

    validationStatus:
      result.validationStatus ||
      null,

    reconciliationStatus:
      result.reconciliationStatus ||
      null

  };

}


async function saveScannedTicket(
  file,
  ocrResult
) {

  /*
    Guest-driver scans must never write directly
    through the normal authenticated FarmVista path.

    They will use the secure guest load-out
    Cloud Function instead.
  */

  if (
    isGuestScan
  ) {

    return await saveGuestScannedTicket(
      file,
      ocrResult
    );

  }


  if (
    !ocrResult?.grainTicket
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "FarmVista did not receive parsed grain-ticket data."
    );

  }


  /*
    OCR must pass before we save anything.
  */

  if (
    ocrResult.scanValid !==
    true
  ) {

    const message =
      Array.isArray(
        ocrResult.scanErrors
      ) &&
      ocrResult.scanErrors.length
        ? ocrResult.scanErrors.join(
            " "
          )
        : "The grain ticket did not pass validation.";


    throw new Error(
      message
    );

  }


  processingText.textContent =
    "Loading FarmVista records…";


  const employee =
    await loadFarmVistaData();


  const grainTicket =
    ocrResult.grainTicket;


  /*
    BUSHEL SANITY CHECK

    OCR can occasionally reverse Shrink Bushels and Net Bushels.

    Gross - Shrink = Net can still mathematically pass when the
    two values are reversed, so we need an additional sanity check
    before this ticket is allowed to save.
  */

  const grossBushels =
    Number(
      grainTicket.grossBushels
    );

  const shrinkBushels =
    Number(
      grainTicket.shrinkBushels ?? 0
    );

  const netBushels =
    Number(
      grainTicket.netBushels
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(grossBushels) ||
    !Number.isFinite(shrinkBushels) ||
    !Number.isFinite(netBushels) ||
    grossBushels <= 0 ||
    netBushels <= 0 ||
    shrinkBushels < 0
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "The grain ticket has invalid bushel values. Please review the ticket."
    );

  }


  /*
    Gross - Shrink must equal Net.
  */

  if (
    Math.abs(
      (
        grossBushels -
        shrinkBushels
      ) -
      netBushels
    ) >
    0.02
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "Gross, shrink, and net bushels do not balance. Please review the ticket."
    );

  }


  /*
    CATCH LIKELY REVERSED SHRINK / NET VALUES

    Net bushels should never reasonably be smaller than shrink,
    and shrink should never consume half or more of the load.

    Do NOT automatically swap the values.
    Stop the ticket and require review instead.
  */

  if (
    netBushels < shrinkBushels ||
    netBushels < grossBushels * 0.50 ||
    shrinkBushels > grossBushels * 0.50
  ) {

    throw new Error(
      "Net Bushels and Shrink Bushels appear to be reversed. Please review the grain ticket."
    );

  }


  let matching =
    matchScannedTicket(
      grainTicket
    );


  matching =
    await runDriverAssistQuestions(
      grainTicket,
      ocrResult,
      matching
    );


  /*
    DUPLICATE PROTECTION

    A ticket is considered a duplicate only when BOTH match:

    1. Elevator / Buyer
    2. Ticket Number

    Check BEFORE uploading the image so duplicate scans
    do not create extra Storage files.
  */

  processingText.textContent =
    "Checking for duplicate ticket…";


  const duplicateTicket =
    await findDuplicateGrainTicket(
      grainTicket,
      matching
    );


  if (
    duplicateTicket
  ) {

    console.warn(
      "[Grain Ticket] Duplicate prevented:",
      {
        existingTicketId:
          duplicateTicket.id,

        ticketNumber:
          grainTicket.ticketNumber,

        elevator:
          grainTicket.elevatorName,

        buyerId:
          matching?.buyerMatch?.buyer?.id ||
          null
      }
    );


    throw new Error(
      "It appears this ticket is already in the system."
    );

  }


  processingText.textContent =
    "Saving ticket image…";


  /*
    IMAGE FIRST.

    If the image upload fails, we do NOT create a Firestore
    grain-ticket record without its original ticket image.
  */

  const image =
    await uploadGrainTicketImage(
      file,
      grainTicket
    );


  processingText.textContent =
    "Saving grain ticket…";


  const customer =
    matching.customerMatch
      ?.customer ||
    null;


  const location =
    matching.locationMatch
      ?.location ||
    null;


  const buyer =
    matching.buyerMatch
      ?.buyer ||
    null;


/*
  CONTRACT AUTO-ALLOCATION

  FarmVista may auto-assign a grain contract ONLY when process of
  elimination leaves exactly one valid contract after the Hauling Job
  and Sold Under / Customer are known.

  Examples:
    - 2 matching hauling jobs -> no hauling job auto-assignment.
    - 1 hauling job + 1 matching John C Dowson contract -> auto-assign.
    - 1 hauling job + 2 matching John C Dowson contracts -> do not guess.
*/
const matchingHaulingJob =
  matching?.haulingJob ||
  null;


const matchingCustomer =
  matching?.customerMatch
    ?.customer ||
  null;


const matchingCrop =
  normalizeScannedCrop(
    grainTicket?.crop
  );


const eligibleContracts =
  (
    matchingHaulingJob &&
    matchingCustomer &&
    matchingCrop
  )
    ? contracts.filter(
        contract => {

          if (
            !contractIsAvailableForDriverAssist(
              contract
            )
          ) {

            return false;

          }


          const contractHaulingJobId =
            String(
              contract?.haulingJobId ||
              ""
            ).trim();


          const contractCustomerId =
            String(
              firstExistingValue(
                contract,
                [
                  "customerId",
                  "grainCustomerId"
                ]
              ) ||
              ""
            ).trim();


          const contractCrop =
            normalizeScannedCrop(
              firstExistingValue(
                contract,
                [
                  "crop",
                  "commodity"
                ]
              )
            );


          return (
            contractHaulingJobId ===
              String(
                matchingHaulingJob.id ||
                ""
              ).trim() &&
            contractCustomerId ===
              String(
                matchingCustomer.id ||
                ""
              ).trim() &&
            contractCrop ===
              matchingCrop
          );

        }
      )
    : [];


const autoContract =
  eligibleContracts.length ===
    1
    ? eligibleContracts[0]
    : null;


const autoContractNumber =
  autoContract
    ? String(
        autoContract.contractNumber ||
        autoContract.number ||
        ""
      ).trim() ||
      null
    : null;


const driverName =
  (
    employee
      ? getEmployeeDisplayName(
          employee
        )
      : ""
  ) ||
  signedInUser?.displayName ||
  signedInUser?.email ||
  (
    isGuestScan
      ? "Guest Driver"
      : "FarmVista Driver"
  );


  const payload = {

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // BUYER / ELEVATOR
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    buyerId:
      buyer?.id ||
      null,

    buyerName:
      buyer
        ? getBuyerName(
            buyer
          )
        : null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // DELIVERY LOCATION SNAPSHOT
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    deliveryLocationId:
      location?.id ||
      null,

    deliveryLocationName:
      location
        ? getLocationName(
            location
          )
        : null,

    deliveryStreet:
      location
        ? getLocationStreet(
            location
          ) || null
        : grainTicket.deliveryStreet ||
          null,

    deliveryCity:
      location
        ? getLocationCity(
            location
          ) || null
        : grainTicket.deliveryCity ||
          null,

    deliveryState:
      location
        ? getLocationState(
            location
          ) || null
        : grainTicket.deliveryState ||
          null,

    deliveryZip:
      location
        ? getLocationZip(
            location
          ) || null
        : grainTicket.deliveryZip ||
          null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // CUSTOMER
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    customerId:
      customer?.id ||
      null,

    customerName:
      customer
        ? getCustomerName(
            customer
          )
        : grainTicket.customerText ||
          null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // HAULING JOB
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    haulingJobId:
      matching.haulingJob?.id ||
      null,

    haulingJobName:
      matching.haulingJob
        ? haulingJobDisplayLabel(
            matching.haulingJob
          ).label
        : null,

    haulingJobLabel:
      matching.haulingJob
        ? haulingJobDisplayLabel(
            matching.haulingJob
          ).label
        : null,

    haulingJobStartingBushels:
      matching.haulingJob
        ? haulingJobStartingBushels(
            matching.haulingJob
          )
        : null,

    haulingJobDeliveryStartDate:
      matching.haulingJob?.deliveryStartDate ||
      matching.haulingJob?.startDate ||
      null,

    haulingJobDeliveryEndDate:
      matching.haulingJob?.deliveryEndDate ||
      matching.haulingJob?.endDate ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // GRAIN SOURCE
    // Driver selects the field or storage SITE.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    grainSourceType:
      matching.grainSource?.type ||
      null,

    grainSourceScope:
      matching.grainSource?.sourceScope ||
      null,

    grainSourceId:
      matching.grainSource?.id ||
      matching.grainSource?.siteId ||
      matching.grainSource?.fieldId ||
      null,

    grainSourceName:
      matching.grainSource?.siteName ||
      matching.grainSource?.fieldName ||
      null,

    grainSourceSiteId:
      matching.grainSource?.siteId ||
      null,

    grainSourceSiteName:
      matching.grainSource?.siteName ||
      null,

    grainSourceFieldId:
      matching.grainSource?.fieldId ||
      null,

    grainSourceFieldName:
      matching.grainSource?.fieldName ||
      null,

    grainSourceBinIndex:
      Number.isFinite(
        Number(
          matching.grainSource?.binIndex
        )
      )
        ? Number(
            matching.grainSource.binIndex
          )
        : null,

    grainSourceBinNum:
      matching.grainSource?.binNumber ??
      null,

    grainSourceBagEventId:
      matching.grainSource?.bagEventId ||
      (
        matching.grainSource?.type ===
          "grain_bag"
          ? matching.grainSource?.id ||
            null
          : null
      ),


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // TICKET
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    ticketNumber:
      grainTicket.ticketNumber,

    ticketDate:
      grainTicket.ticketDate,

    crop:
      grainTicket.crop,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // WEIGHTS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    grossWeight:
      grainTicket.grossWeight,

    tareWeight:
      grainTicket.tareWeight,

    netWeight:
      grainTicket.netWeight,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // GRADE FACTORS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    testWeight:
      grainTicket.testWeight ??
      null,

    moisture:
      grainTicket.moisture ??
      null,

    damage:
      grainTicket.damage ??
      null,

foreignMaterial:
  grainTicket.foreignMaterial ??
  0,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // BUSHELS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    grossBushels:
      grainTicket.grossBushels,

    shrinkBushels:
      grainTicket.shrinkBushels ??
      0,

    netBushels:
      grainTicket.netBushels,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // DRIVER
    // Logged-in FarmVista employee who took the picture.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

 driverEmployeeId:
  employee?.id ||
  null,

    driverUid:
      signedInUser.uid,

    driverName:
      driverName,

    driverEmail:
      signedInUser?.email ||
      employee?.email ||
      null,

    driverPhone:
      signedInUser?.phoneNumber ||
      employee?.phoneE164 ||
      employee?.phone ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // ENTERED BY
    // For OCR entry, driver is also the person who submitted it.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    enteredByUid:
      signedInUser?.uid ||
      null,

    enteredByName:
      driverName,

    enteredByEmail:
      signedInUser?.email ||
      employee?.email ||
      null,

    enteredByPhone:
      signedInUser?.phoneNumber ||
      employee?.phoneE164 ||
      employee?.phone ||
      null,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // SOURCE
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    entryMethod:
      "ocr_scan",


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // ORIGINAL TICKET IMAGE
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    ticketImagePath:
      image.imagePath,

    ticketImageUrl:
      image.imageUrl,


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // OCR SNAPSHOT
    // Keep what OCR actually saw for future office review.
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    ocrElevatorName:
      grainTicket.elevatorName ||
      null,

    ocrDeliveryStreet:
      grainTicket.deliveryStreet ||
      null,

    ocrDeliveryCity:
      grainTicket.deliveryCity ||
      null,

    ocrDeliveryState:
      grainTicket.deliveryState ||
      null,

    ocrDeliveryZip:
      grainTicket.deliveryZip ||
      null,

    ocrCustomerText:
      grainTicket.customerText ||
      null,

    ocrCustomerAccountText:
      grainTicket.customerAccountText ||
      null,

    ocrVehicleId:
      grainTicket.vehicleId ||
      null,

    ocrRawText:
      grainTicket.rawText ||
      ocrResult.document?.text ||
      "",


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // OCR VALIDATION
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    scanValid:
      true,

    scanErrors:
      Array.isArray(
        ocrResult.scanErrors
      )
        ? ocrResult.scanErrors
        : [],

    ocrReviewWarnings:
      Array.isArray(
        ocrResult.reviewWarnings
      )
        ? ocrResult.reviewWarnings
        : [],


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // FARMVISTA MATCHING
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    validationStatus:
      matching.validationStatus,

    reviewReasons:
      matching.reviewReasons,

    customerMatchType:
      matching.customerMatch
        ?.matchType ||
      null,

    deliveryLocationMatchType:
      matching.locationMatch
        ?.matchType ||
      null,

    buyerMatchType:
      matching.buyerMatch
        ?.matchType ||
      null,

// ----------------------------------------------------------
// CONTRACT RECONCILIATION
//
// Auto-assign ONLY when exactly one valid contract remains after
// Hauling Job + Sold Under + Crop are known. Otherwise preserve the
// hauling-job assignment and leave contract allocation unresolved.
// ----------------------------------------------------------

contractId:
  autoContract?.id ||
  null,

contractNumber:
  autoContractNumber,

contractAllocations:
  autoContract
    ? [
        {
          contractId:
            autoContract.id,

          contractNumber:
            autoContractNumber,

          bushels:
            Number(
              grainTicket.netBushels
            ) || 0
        }
      ]
    : [],

allocationModelVersion:
  2,

spotBushels:
  0,

unassignedBushels:
  autoContract
    ? 0
    : (
        Number(
          grainTicket.netBushels
        ) || 0
      ),

reconciliationStatus:
  autoContract
    ? "reconciled"
    : matching.haulingJob
      ? "needs_contract"
      : "needs_review",


    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // TIMESTAMPS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    createdAt:
      serverTimestamp(),

    updatedAt:
      serverTimestamp()

  };


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Saving OCR ticket:",
    payload
  );


  /*
    IDEMPOTENT TICKET SAVE

    Use a stable Firestore document ID based on:

      buyer/elevator + ticket number

    If cell service disappears after Firestore received the
    write but before the phone receives the acknowledgement,
    retrying writes to THIS SAME DOCUMENT instead of creating
    another grain-ticket document.
  */

  const ticketIdentityBuyer =
    String(
      buyer?.id ||
      normalizeMatchText(
        grainTicket.elevatorName
      ) ||
      "unknown-elevator"
    );


  const ticketIdentityNumber =
    String(
      grainTicket.ticketNumber ||
      ""
    ).trim();


  const stableTicketId =
    encodeURIComponent(
      `${ticketIdentityBuyer}__${ticketIdentityNumber}`
    );


  const savedTicket =
    doc(
      db,
      TICKET_COLLECTION,
      stableTicketId
    );


  await retryNetworkAction(
    () =>
      setDoc(
        savedTicket,
        payload
      ),

    "Saving grain ticket"
  );


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] OCR ticket saved:",
    savedTicket.id
  );


  /*
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    BUILD OCR MEMORY
    ----------------------------------------------------------

    The normal grain ticket is already safely saved.

    Memory creation is intentionally BEST-EFFORT.

    If Firestore rules have not yet been opened for
    grain_ocr_memory, we do NOT make the driver's successful
    grain-ticket scan fail. We log the memory error instead.
  */

  let memory =
    null;


  try {

    processingText.textContent =
      "Building OCR memory…";


    memory =
      await saveOcrMemoryRecord({

        savedTicketId:
          savedTicket.id,

        grainTicket,

        ocrResult,

        matching,

        image,

        employee,

        driverName

      });

  }
  catch (
    memoryError
  ) {

    console.error(
      "[Grain Ticket] OCR memory could not be saved:",
      memoryError
    );

  }


  return {
    id:
      savedTicket.id,

    validationStatus:
      matching.validationStatus,

    reviewReasons:
      matching.reviewReasons,

    imagePath:
      image.imagePath,

    imageUrl:
      image.imageUrl,

    memoryId:
      memory?.id ||
      null,

    memoryProfileKey:
      memory?.profileKey ||
      null
  };

}
      
      
// ==========================================================
// CROP SELECTION
// ==========================================================

function normalizeScannedCrop(
  value
) {

  const crop =
    String(
      value ||
      ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();


  if (
    crop.includes(
      "corn"
    )
  ) {

    return "Corn";

  }


  if (
    crop.includes(
      "soy"
    )
  ) {

    return "Soybeans";

  }


  if (
    crop.includes(
      "wheat"
    )
  ) {

    return "Wheat";

  }


  return "";

}


function askDriverForCrop() {

  return new Promise(
    resolve => {

      cropScreen.classList.add(
        "show"
      );


      const choose =
        crop => {

          cropScreen.classList.remove(
            "show"
          );


          resolve(
            crop
          );

        };


      cropCornBtn.onclick =
        () =>
          choose(
            "Corn"
          );


      cropSoybeansBtn.onclick =
        () =>
          choose(
            "Soybeans"
          );


      cropWheatBtn.onclick =
        () =>
          choose(
            "Wheat"
          );

    }
  );

}


      // ==========================================================
      // SCREEN HELPERS
      // ==========================================================

function hideAllScreens() {

  processingScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  resultScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  cropScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  assistScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  errorScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );

}


      function showCameraScreen() {

        hideAllScreens();


        cameraPage.style.display =
          "flex";

      }


      function showProcessing(
        message =
          "Reading ticket information…"
      ) {

        processingText.textContent =
          message;


        processingScreen.classList.add(
          "show"
        );

      }


function showResult() {

  processingScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  errorScreen.classList.remove(
    "show"
  );


  /*
    Outside trucking-company driver:

    One scan only.
    No FarmVista Home button.
    No Scan Another Ticket button.
  */

  if (
    isGuestScan
  ) {

    const resultTitle =
      resultScreen.querySelector(
        ".result-title"
      );


    const resultText =
      resultScreen.querySelector(
        ".result-text"
      );


    if (
      resultTitle
    ) {

      resultTitle.textContent =
        "Grain Ticket Received";

    }


    if (
      resultText
    ) {

      resultText.textContent =
        "Your grain ticket was successfully submitted. You may close this window.";

    }


    retakeBtn.style.display =
      "none";


    homeBtn.style.display =
      "none";

  }


  resultScreen.classList.add(
    "show"
  );

}


      function showError(
        message
      ) {

        processingScreen.classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


        resultScreen.classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


        assistScreen.classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


        errorText.textContent =
          message ||
          "Please try taking the photo again.";


        errorScreen.classList.add(
          "show"
        );

      }



      // ==========================================================
      // CAMERA FRAME POSITION
      // ==========================================================

function resetTicketFramePosition() {

  ticketFrameLocked =
    false;


  ticketFrame.style.left =
    "50%";


  ticketFrame.style.top =
    "50%";


  ticketFrame.style.transform =
    "translate(-50%, -50%)";

}


function lockTicketFramePosition() {

  if (
    ticketFrameLocked ||
    !cameraView
  ) {

    return;

  }


  const viewWidth =
    cameraView.clientWidth;


  const viewHeight =
    cameraView.clientHeight;


  const frameWidth =
    ticketFrame.offsetWidth;


  const frameHeight =
    ticketFrame.offsetHeight;


  if (
    !viewWidth ||
    !viewHeight ||
    !frameWidth ||
    !frameHeight
  ) {

    return;

  }


  /*
    IMPORTANT FOR iPHONE / PWA CAMERA:

    The frame initially appears in the correct centered position.
    Safari can then change the usable viewport when the live camera
    and flashlight finish initializing. If the frame remains centered
    with percentages, that later viewport change moves the box.

    Convert the good initial position to fixed pixel coordinates once
    the video is playing. After that, normal browser viewport changes
    cannot recenter or shift the ticket box.
  */

  const lockedLeft =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.round(
        (viewWidth - frameWidth) / 2
      )
    );


  const lockedTop =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.round(
        (viewHeight - frameHeight) / 2
      )
    );


  ticketFrame.style.left =
    `${lockedLeft}px`;


  ticketFrame.style.top =
    `${lockedTop}px`;


  ticketFrame.style.transform =
    "none";


  ticketFrameLocked =
    true;


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Ticket frame locked.",
    {
      left:
        lockedLeft,

      top:
        lockedTop,

      width:
        frameWidth,

      height:
        frameHeight,

      cameraViewWidth:
        viewWidth,

      cameraViewHeight:
        viewHeight
    }
  );

}

// ==========================================================
// CAMERA IMAGE QUALITY / FOCUS CHECK
// ==========================================================

function stopFocusQualityCheck() {

  if (
    focusCheckTimer
  ) {

    clearInterval(
      focusCheckTimer
    );

  }


  focusCheckTimer =
    null;


  focusStableFrames =
    0;


  lastSharpnessScore =
    0;

}


function calculateCameraSharpness() {

  if (
    !cameraVideo ||
    !cameraVideo.videoWidth ||
    !cameraVideo.videoHeight
  ) {

    return 0;

  }


  /*
    Use a small canvas so this check stays very lightweight.

    We only need enough resolution to tell whether printed
    ticket text has strong edges or is blurry.
  */
  const sampleWidth =
    180;


  const sampleHeight =
    240;


  const canvas =
    document.createElement(
      "canvas"
    );


  canvas.width =
    sampleWidth;


  canvas.height =
    sampleHeight;


  const ctx =
    canvas.getContext(
      "2d",
      {
        willReadFrequently:
          true
      }
    );


  if (
    !ctx
  ) {

    return 0;

  }


  const videoWidth =
    cameraVideo.videoWidth;


  const videoHeight =
    cameraVideo.videoHeight;


  /*
    Analyze the center portion of the camera.

    This is approximately where the grain ticket sits inside
    the FarmVista ticket frame.
  */
  const sourceWidth =
    Math.round(
      videoWidth *
      0.72
    );


  const sourceHeight =
    Math.round(
      videoHeight *
      0.82
    );


  const sourceX =
    Math.round(
      (
        videoWidth -
        sourceWidth
      ) /
      2
    );


  const sourceY =
    Math.round(
      (
        videoHeight -
        sourceHeight
      ) /
      2
    );


  ctx.drawImage(
    cameraVideo,

    sourceX,
    sourceY,
    sourceWidth,
    sourceHeight,

    0,
    0,
    sampleWidth,
    sampleHeight
  );


  const imageData =
    ctx.getImageData(
      0,
      0,
      sampleWidth,
      sampleHeight
    );


  const data =
    imageData.data;


  /*
    Edge-strength measurement.

    Sharp printed numbers and letters have rapid brightness
    changes from one pixel to the next.

    Blurred text has much weaker changes.
  */
  let totalDifference =
    0;


  let comparisons =
    0;


  for (
    let y = 1;
    y < sampleHeight - 1;
    y += 2
  ) {

    for (
      let x = 1;
      x < sampleWidth - 1;
      x += 2
    ) {

      const index =
        (
          y *
          sampleWidth +
          x
        ) *
        4;


      const rightIndex =
        (
          y *
          sampleWidth +
          x +
          1
        ) *
        4;


      const downIndex =
        (
          (
            y +
            1
          ) *
          sampleWidth +
          x
        ) *
        4;


      const gray =
        (
          data[index] *
          0.299
        ) +
        (
          data[index + 1] *
          0.587
        ) +
        (
          data[index + 2] *
          0.114
        );


      const rightGray =
        (
          data[rightIndex] *
          0.299
        ) +
        (
          data[rightIndex + 1] *
          0.587
        ) +
        (
          data[rightIndex + 2] *
          0.114
        );


      const downGray =
        (
          data[downIndex] *
          0.299
        ) +
        (
          data[downIndex + 1] *
          0.587
        ) +
        (
          data[downIndex + 2] *
          0.114
        );


      totalDifference +=
        Math.abs(
          gray -
          rightGray
        );


      totalDifference +=
        Math.abs(
          gray -
          downGray
        );


      comparisons +=
        2;

    }

  }


  if (
    !comparisons
  ) {

    return 0;

  }


  return (
    totalDifference /
    comparisons
  );

}


function startFocusQualityCheck() {

  stopFocusQualityCheck();


  /*
    The shutter is available as soon as the live camera is usable.
    Sharpness only changes the visual feedback; it does not trap
    the driver waiting for a perfect focus score.
  */
  captureBtn.disabled =
    false;


  ticketFrame.classList.remove(
    "ready"
  );


  const cameraTip =
    document.querySelector(
      ".camera-tip"
    );


  if (
    cameraTip
  ) {

    cameraTip.textContent =
      "Keep the whole ticket visible — tap when ready.";

  }


  const checkQuality =
    () => {

      if (
        processing ||
        !cameraTrack ||
        cameraTrack.readyState !==
          "live" ||
        !cameraVideo.videoWidth ||
        !cameraVideo.videoHeight
      ) {

        if (
          !processing
        ) {

          captureBtn.disabled =
            true;

        }


        focusStableFrames =
          0;


        return;

      }


      /*
        Camera is live, so keep Capture available even when the
        current frame is below the preferred sharpness score.
      */
      captureBtn.disabled =
        false;


      let sharpness =
        0;


      try {

        sharpness =
          calculateCameraSharpness();

      }
      catch (err) {

        console.warn(
          "[Grain Ticket] Sharpness check failed:",
          err
        );


        focusStableFrames =
          0;


        ticketFrame.classList.remove(
          "ready"
        );


        return;

      }


      lastSharpnessScore =
        sharpness;


      const sharpEnough =
        sharpness >=
          FOCUS_SHARPNESS_THRESHOLD;


      if (
        sharpEnough
      ) {

        focusStableFrames++;

      }
      else {

        focusStableFrames =
          0;

      }


      const focusReady =
        focusStableFrames >=
          FOCUS_REQUIRED_STABLE_FRAMES;


      ticketFrame.classList.toggle(
        "ready",
        focusReady
      );


      if (
        cameraTip
      ) {

        cameraTip.textContent =
          focusReady
            ? "Looks good — tap to capture."
            : "Tap to capture — FarmVista will choose the sharpest frame.";

      }


      console.log(
        "[Grain Ticket] Camera quality:",
        {
          sharpness:
            Number(
              sharpness.toFixed(
                2
              )
            ),

          preferredThreshold:
            FOCUS_SHARPNESS_THRESHOLD,

          stableFrames:
            focusStableFrames,

          looksReady:
            focusReady,

          shutterAvailable:
            true
        }
      );

    };


  /*
    Give autofocus, exposure and flashlight a brief moment to settle,
    but do not keep the shutter locked while that happens.
  */
  setTimeout(
    () => {

      if (
        !cameraTrack ||
        cameraTrack.readyState !==
          "live"
      ) {

        return;

      }


      checkQuality();


      focusCheckTimer =
        setInterval(
          checkQuality,
          FOCUS_CHECK_INTERVAL
        );

    },
    350
  );

}

      // ==========================================================
      // CAMERA
      // ==========================================================

async function startCamera() {

  stopCamera();

  showCameraScreen();


  resetTicketFramePosition();


  captureBtn.disabled =
    true;

  torchBtn.hidden =
    true;

  torchBtn.classList.remove(
    "active"
  );

  torchBtn.textContent =
    "🔦 Flashlight";

  torchOn =
    false;


  if (
    !navigator.mediaDevices ||
    !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia
  ) {

    showError(
      "Camera access is not available in this browser."
    );

    return;

  }


  try {

    console.log(
      "[Grain Ticket] Starting camera…"
    );


cameraStream =
  await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({

    video: {

      facingMode: {
        ideal:
          "environment"
      },

      width: {
        ideal:
          3840
      },

      height: {
        ideal:
          2160
      }

    },

    audio:
      false

  });


    cameraTrack =
      cameraStream
        .getVideoTracks()[0] ||
      null;
      
      /*
  CAMERA FOCUS

  Ask the rear camera to continuously focus on the grain ticket.
  Only request the feature when the device reports support.
*/

try {

  const capabilities =
    cameraTrack.getCapabilities
      ? cameraTrack.getCapabilities()
      : {};


  if (
    Array.isArray(
      capabilities.focusMode
    ) &&
    capabilities.focusMode.includes(
      "continuous"
    )
  ) {

    await cameraTrack.applyConstraints({

      advanced: [
        {
          focusMode:
            "continuous"
        }
      ]

    });


    console.log(
      "[Grain Ticket] Continuous autofocus enabled."
    );

  }

}
catch (focusErr) {

  console.warn(
    "[Grain Ticket] Autofocus request was not supported:",
    focusErr
  );

}


    if (
      !cameraTrack
    ) {

      throw new Error(
        "No camera video track was available."
      );

    }


    cameraVideo.srcObject =
      cameraStream;


    cameraVideo.muted =
      true;


    cameraVideo.playsInline =
      true;


    await cameraVideo.play();


    /*
      Lock the green ticket frame while the preview is still in its
      original good position. This happens BEFORE flashlight startup,
      because iPhone Safari/PWA can resize its usable camera viewport
      when the torch is enabled.
    */

    await new Promise(
      resolve =>
        requestAnimationFrame(
          () =>
            requestAnimationFrame(
              resolve
            )
        )
    );


    lockTicketFramePosition();


    /*
      Check whether the phone supports the flashlight.
      The existing FarmVista behavior automatically turns it on.
    */

await setupTorch();


/*
  Start lightweight quality feedback. Capture stays available;
  the burst capture will choose the sharpest live frame.
*/
startFocusQualityCheck();


console.log(
  "[Grain Ticket] Camera ready — burst capture enabled.",
      {
        width:
          cameraVideo.videoWidth,

        height:
          cameraVideo.videoHeight,

        trackState:
          cameraTrack.readyState
      }
    );

  }
  catch (err) {

    console.error(
      "[Grain Ticket] Camera failed:",
      err
    );


    stopCamera();


    captureBtn.disabled =
      true;


    const errorName =
      String(
        err?.name ||
        ""
      );


    if (
      errorName ===
        "NotAllowedError" ||
      errorName ===
        "PermissionDeniedError"
    ) {

      showError(
