        "Camera permission is blocked. Allow camera access for FarmVista and try again."
      );

      return;

    }


    showError(
      err?.message ||
      "FarmVista could not start the camera."
    );

  }

}

function stopCamera() {

  stopFocusQualityCheck();


  captureBtn.disabled =
    true;


  if (
    cameraStream
  ) {

          cameraStream
            .getTracks()
            .forEach(
              track => {

                try {
                  track.stop();
                }
                catch (_) {}

              }
            );

        }


        cameraStream =
          null;


        cameraTrack =
          null;


        cameraVideo.srcObject =
          null;


        torchOn =
          false;


        ticketFrame.classList.remove(
          "ready"
        );


        resetTicketFramePosition();

      }



      // ==========================================================
      // FLASHLIGHT
      // ==========================================================

async function setupTorch() {

  torchBtn.hidden =
    true;


  if (
    !cameraTrack ||
    !cameraTrack.getCapabilities
  ) {

    return;

  }


  try {

    const capabilities =
      cameraTrack.getCapabilities();


if (
  capabilities?.torch
) {

  torchBtn.hidden =
    false;


  /*
    Automatically turn the flashlight ON
    when the grain-ticket camera opens.
  */

  await cameraTrack.applyConstraints({
    advanced: [
      {
        torch: true
      }
    ]
  });


  torchOn =
    true;


  torchBtn.classList.add(
    "active"
  );


  torchBtn.textContent =
    "🔦 Flashlight On";

}

  }
  catch (err) {

    console.warn(
      "[Grain Ticket] Torch capability check failed:",
      err
    );


    torchBtn.hidden =
      true;

  }

}


      async function toggleTorch() {

        if (
          !cameraTrack
        ) {
          return;
        }


        try {

          torchOn =
            !torchOn;


          await cameraTrack.applyConstraints({
            advanced: [
              {
                torch:
                  torchOn
              }
            ]
          });


          torchBtn.classList.toggle(
            "active",
            torchOn
          );


          torchBtn.textContent =
            torchOn
              ? "🔦 Flashlight On"
              : "🔦 Flashlight";

        }
        catch (err) {

          console.warn(
            "[Grain Ticket] Torch failed:",
            err
          );


          torchOn =
            false;


          torchBtn.classList.remove(
            "active"
          );

        }

      }



      // ==========================================================
      // CAMERA CAPTURE
      // ==========================================================

      async function captureBestLiveFrame() {

        let bestFrame =
          null;


        let bestScore =
          -1;


        const width =
          cameraVideo.videoWidth;


        const height =
          cameraVideo.videoHeight;


        for (
          let frameIndex = 0;
          frameIndex < CAPTURE_BURST_FRAME_COUNT;
          frameIndex++
        ) {

          if (
            !cameraTrack ||
            cameraTrack.readyState !==
              "live"
          ) {

            break;

          }


          let sharpness =
            0;


          try {

            sharpness =
              calculateCameraSharpness();

          }
          catch (err) {

            console.warn(
              "[Grain Ticket] Burst sharpness check failed:",
              err
            );

          }


          const canvas =
            document.createElement(
              "canvas"
            );


          canvas.width =
            width;


          canvas.height =
            height;


          const ctx =
            canvas.getContext(
              "2d"
            );


          if (
            !ctx
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              "Camera image canvas was unavailable."
            );

          }


          ctx.drawImage(
            cameraVideo,
            0,
            0,
            width,
            height
          );


          if (
            !bestFrame ||
            sharpness >
              bestScore
          ) {

            bestFrame =
              canvas;


            bestScore =
              sharpness;

          }


          if (
            frameIndex <
              CAPTURE_BURST_FRAME_COUNT - 1
          ) {

            await wait(
              CAPTURE_BURST_INTERVAL_MS
            );

          }

        }


        if (
          !bestFrame
        ) {

          throw new Error(
            "No live camera frame was available."
          );

        }


        console.log(
          "[Grain Ticket] Best burst frame selected:",
          {
            framesRequested:
              CAPTURE_BURST_FRAME_COUNT,

            bestSharpness:
              Number(
                Math.max(
                  0,
                  bestScore
                ).toFixed(
                  2
                )
              )
          }
        );


        return bestFrame;

      }



      async function capturePhoto() {

        if (
          processing ||
          !cameraVideo.videoWidth ||
          !cameraVideo.videoHeight
        ) {
          return;
        }


        processing =
          true;


        captureBtn.disabled =
          true;


        const cameraTip =
          document.querySelector(
            ".camera-tip"
          );


        if (
          cameraTip
        ) {

          cameraTip.textContent =
            "Capturing best frame…";

        }


        try {

          /*
            Grab several frames from the live preview over roughly
            a quarter second. This gives a moving/vibrating phone
            multiple chances to catch crisp printed text without
            creating an Apple Live Photo or uploading extra files.
          */
          const bestFrame =
            await captureBestLiveFrame();


          const blob =
            await canvasToBlob(
              bestFrame
            );


          const file =
            new File(
              [blob],
              `grain-ticket-${Date.now()}.jpg`,
              {
                type:
                  "image/jpeg"
              }
            );


          stopCamera();


          await processTicket(
            file
          );

        }
        catch (err) {

          console.error(
            "[Grain Ticket] Capture failed:",
            err
          );


          processing =
            false;


          showError(
            "The photo could not be captured. Please try again."
          );

        }

      }

      // ==========================================================
      // IMAGE PREPARATION
      // ==========================================================

      function canvasToBlob(
        canvas
      ) {

        return new Promise(
          (
            resolve,
            reject
          ) => {

            canvas.toBlob(
              blob => {

                if (blob) {

                  resolve(
                    blob
                  );

                }
                else {

                  reject(
                    new Error(
                      "JPEG conversion failed."
                    )
                  );

                }

              },

              "image/jpeg",

              JPEG_QUALITY
            );

          }
        );

      }


      function readFileAsDataURL(
        file
      ) {

        return new Promise(
          (
            resolve,
            reject
          ) => {

            const reader =
              new FileReader();


            reader.onload =
              () =>
                resolve(
                  reader.result
                );


            reader.onerror =
              () =>
                reject(
                  reader.error
                );


            reader.readAsDataURL(
              file
            );

          }
        );

      }


      function loadImage(
        src
      ) {

        return new Promise(
          (
            resolve,
            reject
          ) => {

            const img =
              new Image();


            img.onload =
              () =>
                resolve(
                  img
                );


            img.onerror =
              reject;


            img.src =
              src;

          }
        );

      }


      async function prepareImage(
        rawFile
      ) {

        if (
          !rawFile
        ) {
          return null;
        }


        if (
          !String(
            rawFile.type || ""
          ).startsWith(
            "image/"
          )
        ) {

          return rawFile;

        }


        const dataUrl =
          await readFileAsDataURL(
            rawFile
          );


        const img =
          await loadImage(
            dataUrl
          );


        const srcWidth =
          img.naturalWidth ||
          img.width;


        const srcHeight =
          img.naturalHeight ||
          img.height;


        const longest =
          Math.max(
            srcWidth,
            srcHeight
          );


        let scale =
          1;


        if (
          longest >
          MAX_IMAGE_SIDE
        ) {

          scale =
            MAX_IMAGE_SIDE /
            longest;

        }


        const width =
          Math.round(
            srcWidth *
            scale
          );


        const height =
          Math.round(
            srcHeight *
            scale
          );


        const canvas =
          document.createElement(
            "canvas"
          );


        canvas.width =
          width;


        canvas.height =
          height;


        const ctx =
          canvas.getContext(
            "2d"
          );


        ctx.drawImage(
          img,
          0,
          0,
          width,
          height
        );


        const blob =
          await canvasToBlob(
            canvas
          );


        return new File(
          [blob],

          `grain-ticket-${Date.now()}.jpg`,

          {
            type:
              "image/jpeg"
          }
        );

      }



      // ==========================================================
      // BASE64
      // ==========================================================

      async function fileToBase64(
        file
      ) {

        const dataUrl =
          await readFileAsDataURL(
            file
          );


        const parts =
          String(
            dataUrl || ""
          ).split(
            ","
          );


        return parts.length > 1
          ? parts[1]
          : "";

      }



      // ==========================================================
      // OCR
      // ==========================================================

      async function processTicket(
        rawFile
      ) {

        showProcessing(
          "Preparing grain ticket…"
        );


        try {

          const file =
            await prepareImage(
              rawFile
            );


          if (
            !file
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              "No image was available."
            );

          }


          processingText.textContent =
            "Reading grain ticket…";


          const base64 =
            await fileToBase64(
              file
            );


          if (
            !base64
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              "Could not read the ticket image."
            );

          }


          console.log(
            "[Grain Ticket] Sending to OCR:",
            {
              mode:
                "grain_ticket",

              mimeType:
                file.type,

              size:
                file.size
            }
          );


          const response =
            await fetchWithCellRetry(
              OCR_URL,
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "Content-Type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    mode:
                      "grain_ticket",

                    content:
                      base64,

                    mimeType:
                      file.type ||
                      "image/jpeg"
                  })
              },

              "Reading grain ticket"
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {

            const serverText =
              await response.text();


            console.error(
              "[Grain Ticket] OCR HTTP error:",
              response.status,
              serverText
            );


            throw new Error(
              `OCR server returned ${response.status}.`
            );

          }


          const result =
            await response.json();

          /*
            FarmVista verification layer:
            Re-associate explicit grade labels (TW/MO/DM/FM/SP) with the
            values OCR already recognized before validation or save.
          */
          normalizeGrainTicketGrades(result);
            
            /*
/*
  OCR GRADE FIELD SAFETY

  fvOcr may return the correctly recognized value in result.fields
  while grainTicket contains an older/default/parser value.

  result.fields is the direct structured OCR result, so when it
  contains a valid numeric grade value, copy that exact value into
  grainTicket before FarmVista validates or saves the ticket.

  ADM FALLBACK:
  Some ADM tickets OCR the FM value correctly in the raw document
  text (example 00.8) while the structured foreignMaterial field
  comes back as 0. This fallback only runs for ADM tickets and only
  replaces FM when the structured/parser result is zero or missing.
*/

function getOcrNumericField(field) {

  if (
    field === null ||
    field === undefined ||
    field === ""
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  let rawValue =
    field;

  if (
    typeof field === "object"
  ) {

    rawValue =
      field.value ??
      field.normalizedValue ??
      field.text ??
      field.rawValue ??
      null;

  }

  const cleaned =
    String(
      rawValue ?? ""
    )
      .replace(
        /[^0-9.-]/g,
        ""
      )
      .trim();

  if (
    !cleaned
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const number =
    Number(
      cleaned
    );

  return Number.isFinite(
    number
  )
    ? number
    : null;

}


if (
  result.grainTicket &&
  result.fields
) {

  const directFields = [
    [
      "testWeight",
      "testWeight"
    ],
    [
      "moisture",
      "moisture"
    ],
    [
      "damage",
      "damage"
    ],
    [
      "foreignMaterial",
      "foreignMaterial"
    ]
  ];


  directFields.forEach(
    ([
      fieldName,
      ticketName
    ]) => {

      const value =
        getOcrNumericField(
          result.fields[
            fieldName
          ]
        );


      if (
        value !== null
      ) {

        console.log(
          `[Grain Ticket] OCR direct field ${fieldName}:`,
          {
            directOcrValue:
              value,

            parserValue:
              result.grainTicket[
                ticketName
              ]
          }
        );


        result.grainTicket[
          ticketName
        ] =
          value;

      }

    }
  );

}


/*
  NOTE:
  ADM-specific grade-factor interpretation belongs in the OCR
  backend / Google function. FarmVista should consume the OCR
  function's structured values rather than maintain a second
  ADM parser here.
*/




          console.log(
            "=================================================="
          );


          console.log(
            "[Grain Ticket] FULL OCR RESULT"
          );


          console.log(
            result
          );


          console.log(
            "[Grain Ticket] OCR FIELDS"
          );


          console.table(
            result.fields ||
            {}
          );


          console.log(
            "[Grain Ticket] DOCUMENT TEXT"
          );


          console.log(
            result.document?.text ||
            ""
          );


          console.log(
            "=================================================="
          );


          if (
            !result.ok
          ) {

            throw new Error(
              result.error ||
              "OCR could not process the grain ticket."
            );

          }
          
          /*
  TEST WEIGHT SANITY CHECK

  Do not silently save a suspicious OCR reading.

  Example:
    actual ticket = 57.2
    blurry OCR     = 67.2

  We do NOT auto-change 67.2 to 57.2.
  We require another picture instead.
*/

const scannedTestWeight =
  Number(
    result.grainTicket
      ?.testWeight
  );


const scannedCropForGradeCheck =
  String(
    result.grainTicket
      ?.crop ||
    ""
  )
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();


if (
  Number.isFinite(
    scannedTestWeight
  ) &&
  (
    scannedCropForGradeCheck ===
      "corn" ||
    scannedCropForGradeCheck ===
      "yellow corn"
  ) &&
  (
    scannedTestWeight <
      45 ||
    scannedTestWeight >
      65
  )
) {

  throw new Error(
    `Test Weight ${scannedTestWeight.toFixed(1)} looks unusual for corn. Please take a clearer picture of the ticket.`
  );

}


const documentText =
  String(
    result.document?.text ||
    ""
  ).trim();


if (
  documentText.length <
  10
) {

  throw new Error(
    "FarmVista did not read enough information from this ticket."
  );

}

          /*
  CROP

  First use the crop OCR found.

  If OCR did not identify the crop,
  ask the driver to select it before saving.
*/

/*
  CROP

  Preserve exactly what OCR originally returned.

  If OCR cannot determine crop, ask the driver.

  IMPORTANT:
  fvOcr already calculated scanValid + scanErrors BEFORE
  the driver answered this question.

  Therefore, after a driver supplies a valid crop we remove
  ONLY the crop-related validation error and recalculate
  scanValid. All other OCR errors remain untouched.
*/

const originalOcrCrop =
  result.grainTicket?.crop ??
  null;


let scannedCrop =
  normalizeScannedCrop(
    originalOcrCrop
  );


let cropSelectedByDriver =
  false;


if (
  !scannedCrop &&
  !isGuestScan
) {

  /*
    NORMAL FARMVISTA SCAN

    Do NOT ask for Crop here anymore.

    The driver selects the Hauling Job during Driver Assist,
    and that job supplies the authoritative Crop, Destination,
    Buyer, and Sold Under values.
  */

  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] OCR did not identify crop. Hauling Job will supply crop."
  );

}


if (
  !scannedCrop &&
  isGuestScan
) {

  /*
    SMS / LOAD-OUT SCAN

    DO NOT ask the driver.

    The secure saveGuestGrainTicket backend knows the assigned
    load and will use the load's authoritative crop.

    Preserve null here so we never create a false OCR-learning
    relationship such as:

      null -> Corn
  */

  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Guest OCR did not identify crop. Load-out crop will be used."
  );

}


/*
  Put the final crop onto the structured grain ticket.
*/

if (
  scannedCrop
) {

  result.grainTicket.crop =
    scannedCrop;

}


/*
  Record the HUMAN correction separately.

  The OCR memory writer will preserve this so later we know:

    OCR said:
      null

    Driver said:
      Corn

  That is real learning information.
*/

if (
  cropSelectedByDriver
) {

  result.manualCorrections = {

    ...(
      result.manualCorrections ||
      {}
    ),

    crop: {

      originalValue:
        originalOcrCrop,

      selectedValue:
        scannedCrop,

      source:
        "driver_selection",

      learningEligible:
        Boolean(
          String(
            originalOcrCrop ??
            ""
          ).trim()
        ),

      learningReason:
        String(
          originalOcrCrop ??
          ""
        ).trim()
          ? "ocr_evidence_confirmed"
          : "driver_supplied_missing_value"

    }

  };


  /*
    Remove ONLY crop-related validation errors.

    Never clear a weight error, ticket-number error,
    grade-factor error, etc.
  */

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      result.scanErrors
    )
  ) {

    result.scanErrors =
      result.scanErrors.filter(
        error => {

          const text =
            String(
              error ||
              ""
            )
              .trim()
              .toLowerCase();


          if (
            !text.includes(
              "crop"
            )
          ) {

            return true;

          }


          const cropError =
            (
              text.includes(
                "could not be read"
              ) ||
              text.includes(
                "could not determine"
              ) ||
              text.includes(
                "must be selected"
              ) ||
              text.includes(
                "not identified"
              )
            );


          return !cropError;

        }
      );

  }


  /*
    OCR validation has now been repaired with the
    driver's answer.

    If another problem remains, scanValid stays false.
  */

  result.scanValid =
    !Array.isArray(
      result.scanErrors
    ) ||
    result.scanErrors.length ===
      0;


  console.log(
    "[Grain Ticket] Driver supplied missing crop:",
    {
      originalOcrCrop,
      selectedCrop:
        scannedCrop,

      remainingScanErrors:
        result.scanErrors,

      scanValid:
        result.scanValid
    }
  );

}

/*
  DEFERRED CROP RECOVERY

  If OCR failed ONLY because Crop was missing, remove just the crop
  error here. A normal FarmVista scan gets its authoritative Crop from
  the selected Hauling Job. A guest/SMS scan gets Crop from its assigned
  load-out backend. Never clear weight, ticket-number, grade, or other
  scan errors.
*/

if (
  !scannedCrop &&
  Array.isArray(
    result.scanErrors
  )
) {

  result.scanErrors =
    result.scanErrors.filter(
      error =>
        !String(
          error ||
          ""
        )
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(
            "crop"
          )
    );


  result.scanValid =
    result.scanErrors.length ===
      0;

}


/*
  HARD OCR VALIDATION

  If fvOcr says this ticket is not valid,
  the driver must rescan it.
*/

if (
  result.scanValid !==
  true
) {

  const scanMessage =
    Array.isArray(
      result.scanErrors
    ) &&
    result.scanErrors.length
      ? result.scanErrors.join(
          " "
        )
      : "FarmVista could not verify this grain ticket. Please rescan it.";


  throw new Error(
    scanMessage
  );

}


/*
  FINAL CROP SAFETY CHECK.

  At this point Crop either came from OCR
  or was selected by the driver.
*/

const validScannedCrops =
  [
    "Corn",
    "Soybeans",
    "Wheat"
  ];


if (
  scannedCrop &&
  !validScannedCrops.includes(
    scannedCrop
  )
) {

  throw new Error(
    "The scanned crop is not supported by FarmVista."
  );

}


/*
  Keep the prepared image so the exact image that OCR read
  is the image saved with the grain ticket.
*/

currentTicketFile =
  file;


processingText.textContent =
  "Saving grain ticket…";


const savedTicket =
  await saveScannedTicket(
    currentTicketFile,
    result
  );


console.log(
  "[Grain Ticket] Save complete:",
  savedTicket
);


processing =
  false;


showResult();



        }
        catch (err) {

          console.error(
            "[Grain Ticket] Processing failed:",
            err
          );


          processing =
            false;


          showError(
            err?.message ||
            "FarmVista could not read this grain ticket. Please try again."
          );

        }

      }

===== SCAN getTicketHeaderText =====

function getTicketHeaderText(
  grainTicket
) {

  /*
    Only use the TOP of the ticket to identify the elevator.

    This prevents later lines such as:

      JOHN C DOWSON
      DIVERNON IL
      CHS Elevators Sycamore IL

    from being mistaken for the destination.
  */

  return getOcrLines(
    grainTicket
  )
    .slice(
      0,
      8
    )
    .join(
      " "
    );

}
